papers.title: Thin-film lithium tantalate for ultraviolet integrated electro-optic modulator
papers.abstract_en: Abstract The realization of integrated, high-speed ultraviolet modulation is pivotal for the advancement of quantum information processing, portable atomic clocks, and secure solar-blind communications. While mature photonic platforms have enabled sophisticated system-level integration across the visible and infrared spectral ranges, high-speed active modulation in the ultraviolet remains largely dependent on conventional bulk-crystal technologies. Consequently, a scalable integrated solution that simultaneously combines low insertion loss and extreme compactness with high modulation efficiency has remained challenging. Here, we report an integrated UV electro-optic modulator on a thin-film lithium tantalate platform. The device has a compact lumped-electrode of 200 μ m, exhibiting a measured 3 dB electrical-to-optical-to-electrical bandwidth above 40 GHz, a high modulation efficiency V π L of 85 mV ⋅ cm, and a measured electrical-to-electrical bandwidth beyond 67 GHz. This work establishes thin-film lithium tantalate as a disruptive platform for wafer-scale compatible active UV photonics, enabling the next generation of scalable quantum and communication systems.
papers.summary_ko: 초박막 리튬탄탈레이트(LiTaO3) 박막을 이용한 자외선 집적 전기광학 변조기를 구현했다. 200 μm 길이의 집중전극 구조로 40 GHz 이상의 3dB 전기-광-전기 대역폭과 85 mV·cm의 변조 효율(VπL), 67 GHz 이상의 전기-전기 대역폭을 달성했다. 이는 양자정보처리 및 보안 통신용 UV 포토닉스를 위한 웨이퍼 스케일 집적 플랫폼으로서의 가능성을 보여준다.

papers.title: Stabilizing Oxygen Redox in Polycrystalline Li‐Rich Layered Cathodes via Efficient Grain Boundary Passivation
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT High‐voltage cathodes with hybrid anion and cation redox activities, such as Li‐rich and Mn‐rich oxides, offer a pathway to higher energy density in lithium‐ion batteries (LIBs). However, those cathodes suffer from oxygen loss from both the surface and grain boundaries, especially in traditional polycrystalline cathodes with secondary‐particle morphology. Interfacial passivation is needed, yet uniform, high‐quality coating at both primary‐ and secondary‐particle levels remains challenging. Here, using a tannic acid‐assisted process, we demonstrate an in situ formed Ba M O 3− δ ( M = Ni, Co, and Mn) perovskite phase at surfaces and grain boundaries, offering effective passivation to suppress structural and electrochemical degradation. Differential electrochemical mass spectrometry (DEMS), soft X‐ray spectroscopy (SXAS) and resonant inelastic X‐ray spectroscopy (RIXS) reveal that the passivated grain boundaries effectively mitigate oxygen release, promote the retention of oxidized oxygen within the grains, and improve oxygen‐redox reversibility. The stabilization is facilitated by strong M ─O bonding at primary‐particle surfaces, improving energy‐density stability and mitigating voltage decay. The improved electrochemical performance results from the reliable coating method, which constructs sequential interfacial bonding along grain boundaries. Using earth‐abundant elements only, this process may offer high‐quality passivation for a variety of oxide cathodes used in LIBs and beyond.
papers.summary_ko: 탄닌산을 활용한 공정으로 Li-rich/Mn-rich 층상 양극의 1차 입자 표면 및 결정립계에 BaMO3-δ 페로브스카이트 상을 형성시켜 산소 손실을 억제했다. DEMS, SXAS, RIXS 분석을 통해 패시베이션된 결정립계가 산소 방출을 완화하고 산화된 산소를 입자 내에 유지시켜 음이온 레독스 가역성을 향상시킴을 확인했다. M-O 결합 강화로 전압 감소 억제 및 에너지밀도 안정성이 개선되었으며, 희귀 금속 없이도 적용 가능한 코팅법이다.

papers.title: Redirecting Bond Cleavage in Sacrificial Prelithiation via Dual‐Side Separator Engineering for Anode‐Free Lithium Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Anode‐free lithium metal batteries (AFLMBs) promise extreme gravimetric and volumetric energy densities but suffer from irreversible active lithium loss, sluggish desolvation kinetics, and dendritic proliferation. Herein, we report a catalyst‐induced bond‐cleavage redirection concept to unlock efficient sacrificial prelithiation, implemented via a dual‐side functionalized separator. On the cathode side, a 5 µm MoC 1‐x /NC‐0.3Co coating redirects Li 2 C 2 O 4 decomposition from high‐barrier Li–O cleavage to preferential C─C bond scission. Theoretical calculations and operando characterizations confirm this mechanistic shift, lowering the delithiation potential to 3.79 V at 60°C with a 99.5% Li + utilization rate. To safeguard the liberated lithium inventory against depletion, the anode side integrates a PSSLi‐PFPE bilayer. This coating accelerates Li + desolvation and drives the in‐situ construction of a LiF‐rich solid electrolyte interphase, enabling Li symmetric cells cycling for over 1700 h (1.0 mAh cm −2 , DOD = 80.7%). Bridging fundamental bond kinetics with practical engineering, the assembled 1.0 Ah anode‐free pouch cell (NCM811||MoC 1‐x /NC‐0.3Co‐LCO/PE/PSSLi‐PFPE||Cu) achieves gravimetric and volumetric energy densities of 458.6 Wh kg −1 and 1005.2 Wh L −1 , a power output of 989.1 W kg −1 , retaining 80.1% capacity after 100 cycles. This non‐invasive separator strategy provides a unified framework connecting bond kinetics to practical cell manufacturing, charting a feasible avenue for high‐energy AFLMBs.
papers.summary_ko: 무음극(anode-free) 리튬금속전지의 비가역적 리튬 손실 문제를 해결하기 위해 양면 기능화 분리막을 이용한 촉매 유도 결합 절단 재지향 전략을 제시했다. 양극측 MoC1-x/NC-0.3Co 코팅이 Li2C2O4 분해 경로를 C-C 결합 절단으로 전환시켜 60°C에서 3.79V의 낮은 탈리튬화 전위와 99.5%의 리튬 이용률을 달성했고, 음극측 PSSLi-PFPE 이중층이 LiF가 풍부한 SEI 형성을 촉진해 1700시간 이상의 대칭셀 사이클링을 구현했다. 1.0 Ah 무음극 파우치셀은 458.6 Wh/kg, 1005.2 Wh/L의 에너지밀도와 100사이클 후 80.1%의 용량 유지율을 보였다.

papers.title: Nanocast sodium metasurfaces for enhanced light-matter coupling
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Sodium has been proven to be a plasmonic material superior to noble metals. However, its high chemical reactivity poses a major obstacle to direct nanopatterning via conventional techniques, hindering the pursuit of sodium metasurfaces that simultaneously deliver high coupling efficiency and high quality factor. In this work, we developed a nanocast sodium-argon metasurface by rapidly cooling liquid sodium on a polymethyl methacrylate nanomold. This metasurface supports high-Q plasmonic resonances with record-high performance, surpassing previously reported alkali metal plasmonic systems. The liquid sodium consistently maintains an ultra-low filling depth regardless of the mold depth, which not only creates a nonlocal photonic configuration but also affords precise control over the radiative-to-dissipative loss ratio. Such casting behavior enables the metasurface to transition from under-coupling to critical-coupling regimes, thereby achieving high-efficiency, tunable second harmonic generation. We further provide direct experimental evidence that sodium outperforms silver in nonlinear optical performance. By leveraging the robustness inherent to the nonlocal nanocasting technique for sodium-argon metasurfaces, we demonstrate a large-area second harmonic generation metasurface with polarization-switchable imaging. The proposed sodium nanocasting technique opens an alternative avenue for sustainable high-performance plasmonics.
papers.summary_ko: 액체 나트륨을 PMMA 나노몰드에 급속 냉각시켜 나노주조 방식으로 소듐-아르곤 메타표면을 제작했다. 이 구조는 몰드 깊이와 무관하게 초저충전 깊이를 유지하며 고Q값 플라즈모닉 공명과 비국소 광학 거동을 구현해 기존 알칼리 금속 플라즈모닉 시스템을 능가하는 2차 고조파 발생 성능을 보였다. 소듐이 은(Ag)보다 우수한 비선형 광학 특성을 가짐을 실험적으로 입증하고, 대면적 편광 전환 이미징이 가능한 메타표면을 구현했다.

papers.title: Gradient Mg and Uniform Ti Co‐Doping Suppresses Jahn–Teller Effect in LMFP via Optimized Ion‐Transport Kinetics and Interfacial Reactions
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT LiMn 0.6 Fe 0.4 PO 4 (LMFP), an olivine‐type cathode material, is gaining attention in high‐energy‐density lithium‐ion batteries due to its high operating voltage and cost‐effectiveness. However, its practical use is limited by slow Li + diffusion, poor electronic conductivity, and structural degradation caused by Jahn–Teller distortion from Mn 3+ . To tackle these challenges, we have developed a dry‐and‐wet synthesis method to produce Mg/Ti co‐doped LMFP (Mg/Ti‐LMFP). This approach ensures uniform Ti 4+ doping at Fe sites and gradient Mg 2+ doping at Li sites. Ti 4+ strengthens the structural stability by forming M─O bonds, reducing Jahn–Teller distortion. Additionally, surface‐enriched Mg 2+ creates a protective layer, preventing manganese dissolution and electrolyte decomposition. The optimized structure and chemistry enhance Li + transport kinetics, stability, electronic conductivity, and cycling durability. Mg/Ti‐LMFP demonstrates 88.7% capacity retention after 200 cycles at 1C (25°C) and 88.2% after 100 cycles at 1C (55°C). This study lays a solid foundation for designing high‐performance co‐doped olivine‐type cathode materials, guiding the development of future energy storage solutions.
papers.summary_ko: LiMn0.6Fe0.4PO4(LMFP) 올리빈 양극재의 얀-텔러 왜곡 문제를 해결하기 위해 Fe 사이트에 균일한 Ti4+ 도핑과 Li 사이트에 구배형 Mg2+ 도핑을 적용한 건식-습식 복합 합성법을 개발했다. Ti4+가 M-O 결합을 강화해 구조 안정성을 높이고, 표면에 농축된 Mg2+가 보호층을 형성해 망간 용출과 전해질 분해를 억제했다. Mg/Ti 공동도핑 LMFP는 1C, 25°C에서 200사이클 후 88.7%, 55°C에서 100사이클 후 88.2%의 용량 유지율을 보였다.

papers.title: Discovering Underpotentially Deposited Crystalline Sodium Metal Nanoparticles on the Surface of Hard Carbon Anodes
papers.venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Sodium-ion batteries are attractive candidates for low-cost and scalable energy storage in which hard carbon (HC) anodes are used. However, sodium (Na) metal plating in HC anodes at voltages above the plating potential remains a critical problem. The location and spatial distribution of crystalline sodium (c-Na) metal nanoparticles, the clusters associated with Na storage in HCs, are important for understanding this underpotential plating behavior but remain unclear. Here, we implement a cryogenic electron microscopy (cryo-EM) and electron tomography (cryo-ET) workflow that directly localizes c-Na metal clusters in sodiated HC samples: cryo-ET maps nanoscale three-dimensional (3D) distributions, while cryo-EM resolves local structure and chemistry. Our workflow reveals that c-Na metal clusters reside predominantly on the surfaces or near surfaces of individual HC particles. This finding challenges existing interpretations in the literature that locate the c-Na metal clusters within closed nanopores in the bulk of the HC, presumably because prior characterization using nonimaging techniques and two-dimensional (2D) projection images associated with traditional transmission electron microscopy (TEM) lacks the spatial 3D information necessary to resolve the full spatial distribution. Our discovery is an important step toward explaining the underpotential plating phenomenon of Na metal in HC anodes, suggesting that particle-level surface and near-surface interfaces are relevant targets to mitigate plating alongside bulk-pore, electrode, and electrolyte/interphase design.
papers.summary_ko: 극저온 전자현미경(cryo-EM)과 전자토모그래피(cryo-ET)를 결합해 나트륨이온전지 하드카본 음극 내 결정질 소듐 금속 나노입자의 3차원 분포를 직접 관찰했다. 결과적으로 c-Na 금속 클러스터는 하드카본 입자 내부의 폐쇄 기공이 아니라 입자 표면 및 근방에 주로 위치함을 밝혀, 기존 통념을 뒤집는 발견을 제시했다. 이는 하드카본 음극에서의 언더포텐셜 소듐 금속 도금 현상을 이해하는 데 중요한 단서를 제공한다.

papers.title: Bifunctional Additive Enabled Thermoresponsive Electrolytes With Dual‐Mode Manipulation Toward Safe Lithium Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Thermal safety issues arising from electrolyte instability at elevated temperatures pose a critical challenge for lithium (Li) metal batteries (LMBs). Thermoresponsive electrolytes offer a promising solution, yet battery systems with high‐rate capability and reliable thermal protection have not been realized. Herein, we introduce a bifunctional LiNO 3 additive into a high‐volume‐fraction vinylene carbonate‐based thermoresponsive electrolyte (HVCE‐N) to enhance the performance of LMBs at room and elevated temperatures. Notably, the introduction of the LiNO 3 additive modifies the solvation structure of Li + and forms a Li 3 N/LiN x O y solid electrolyte interface with high ionic conductivity. Under thermal shock, HVCE‐N undergoes a rapid liquid‐to‐solid phase transition upon free radical polymerization to form a polymer network. More importantly, LiNO 3 can regulate the free radical concentration to control the degree of polymerization, thereby preserving high ion transport capability even after phase transition. As a result, a Li||NCM811 cell based on HVCE‐N exhibits high‐rate performance from 1C to 10C, and stable cycling at 100°C. When subjected to a thermal shock of 200°C, HVCE‐N suppresses thermal runaway for Li||NCM811 pouch cell. This electrolyte design offers a new strategy to develop highly safe LMBs with high‐rate performance.
papers.summary_ko: 전압응답형 전해질에 이중기능 LiNO3 첨가제를 도입해 상온 및 고온에서 리튬금속전지 성능을 향상시켰다. LiNO3는 Li+ 용매화 구조를 조절해 Li3N/LiNxOy 계면을 형성하고, 열충격 시 라디칼 중합을 통한 액체-고체 전이의 중합도를 제어해 상전이 후에도 높은 이온전달능력을 유지시킨다. Li||NCM811 셀은 1C~10C의 고율 성능과 100°C에서의 안정적 사이클링을 보였으며 200°C 열충격에서도 열폭주를 억제했다.

papers.title: Time‐Domain Regulation of Electrolyte Microenvironments Enables 30 mA cm − 2 Stable Lithium Plating/Stripping for High‐Voltage Lithium Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT The practical application of high‐voltage lithium metal batteries (LMBs) is severely hindered by interfacial instability and structural degradation, fundamentally originating from “time‐domain mismatch” between rapid parasitic reactions and sluggish interface passivation. Herein, we propose a time‐domain responsive in situ gel polymer electrolyte (SiNCO‐GPE) to dynamically regulate the electrolyte microenvironment. The (trimethylsilyl)isocyanate (SiNCO) acts as a “scavenging cage” to eliminate trace water and hydrogen fluoride, while its reaction products subsequently participate in interfacial evolution. The in situ polymerized poly(vinylene carbonate) integrated with poly(vinylidene fluoride‐co‐hexafluoropropylene) electrospun fiber skeleton creates a F‐O co‐coordination environment to facilitate fast Li + transport. The electroactive isocyanate group in SiNCO, together with lithium difluoro(oxalato)borate and fluoroethylene carbonate, decomposes preferentially to rapidly construct a robust B/N/F‐rich interphase layer during initial cycling on both the anode and cathode, while the Si‐containing scavenging products are dynamically incorporated into the interphase layers during prolonged cycling to accommodate mechanical stress. The SiNCO‐GPE enables exceptional Li plating/stripping stability for over 4000 h at 1 mA cm − 2 and withstands an ultrahigh current density of 30 mA cm − 2 over 70 h, while the Li||LiNi 0.8 Co 0.1 Mn 0.1 O 2 cell delivers an outstanding capacity retention of 90.5% after 500 cycles at 4.7 V, offering new insights into the development of durable high‐voltage LMBs.

papers.title: Lattice‐Level Negative Thermal Expansion Enables Thermomechanical Self‐Compensation in High‐Rate Lithium Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Localized Joule heating in high‐rate lithium metal batteries often induces severe thermomechanical failure of polymer separators and accelerates thermal runaway in cells with Ni‐rich NCM cathode. Here we report a multiscale separator design strategy that translates lattice‐level negative thermal expansion into macroscopic thermomechanical self‐compensation. In this design, Cu 2 P 2 O 7 is coupled with the PVDF‐HFP matrix through a PDA mediated interface. Temperature‐dependent structural analysis and thermal‐response tests demonstrate the anisotropic lattice contraction of Cu 2 P 2 O 7 , which relieves the thermally induced deformation of PVDF‐HFP through PDA mediated interfacial interactions. The amine‐rich PDA layer further suppresses corrosive hydrofluoric acid during the cycling, improving interfacial durability. The resulting composite membrane maintains complete dimensional stability up to 200°C while preserving high ionic conductivity and a uniform Li + flux. As a result, Li||Li symmetric cells with the self‐compensating separator operate for more than 3000 h at 1 mA cm −2 . When paired with Ni‐rich NCM811 cathodes, full cells maintain 1000 stable cycles at 5 C and deliver 135 mAh g −1 at 60°C after 100 cycles. This work demonstrates a solid‐state negative thermal expansion strategy for active separator protection, providing a materials route for mitigating thermomechanical failure in high‐power lithium metal batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 리튬금속전지의 국부적 줄열로 인한 분리막 열역학적 파손을 해결하기 위해 격자 수준의 음열팽창 특성을 활용한 다중스케일 분리막 설계를 제시했다. PDA를 매개로 Cu2P2O7을 PVDF-HFP 매트릭스에 결합시켜 비등방성 격자 수축이 PVDF-HFP의 열변형을 상쇄하도록 했으며, 아민이 풍부한 PDA층이 불산 부식을 억제해 계면 내구성을 높였다. 이 분리막은 200°C까지 치수 안정성을 유지했고, Li||Li 대칭셀은 3000시간 이상, Ni-rich NCM811 완전셀은 5C에서 1000사이클 안정적으로 작동했다.

papers.title: Dynamically adaptive soft bioelectronics for neuro-immunomodulatory cancer therapy
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Many solid tumors remain refractory to immunotherapy due to profoundly immunosuppressive tumor microenvironments. Although vagus nerve stimulation offers a direct neural axis to reprogram immune function, its potential in cancer immunotherapy remains unrealized due to the absence of stable, system-level neuromodulation platforms. Herein, we develop a miniature subdiaphragmatic vagus nerve stimulator (SVNS) for near-organ neuromodulation of pancreatic tumor immunity. To construct stable electrical coupling with subdiaphragmatic vagus nerve (SVN) along the esophagus, a dynamically adaptive neural interface comprising an injectable anti-fatigue adhesive conductive hydrogel and a deformable liquid metal electrode is explored. The SVNS is integrated with a battery-free lead-free wireless power module, which can be configured into a Swiss-roll architecture, enabling minimally invasive implantation. In an orthotopic mouse model of pancreatic tumor, chronic SVN stimulation using SVNS suppressed tumor growth and metastasis, reshaped tumor innervation, promoted a shift toward an M1-like TAM phenotype, enhanced cytotoxic immune cell infiltration, and further potentiated the efficacy of anti-PD-1 immunotherapy.
papers.summary_ko: 미주신경 자극을 통한 췌장암 면역치료를 위한 동적 적응형 소프트 생체전자소자에 관한 연구. 전도성 하이드로젤과 액체금속 전극, 무전지 무선 전력 모듈을 결합해 종양 미세환경을 재프로그래밍하는 내용으로, 배터리 소재/전기화학과는 무관함.

papers.title: Dual‐Axial Nitrogen Coordination‐Induced Mn Charge Localization at Fe‐Mn Dual‐Atom Sites for Enhanced Sulfur Redox Kinetics
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT The optimization of coordination environments for heteronuclear dual‐atom catalysts (DACs) has been a formidable challenge in lithium‐sulfur (Li‐S) batteries, arising from complex electronic coupling induced by inherent inter‐metallic‐site charge transfer at heteronuclear sites. Herein, an Fe‐Mn dual‐atom catalyst (FeMn‐(N ax ) 2 DAC/NC) with dual‐axial nitrogen coordination anchored on nitrogen‐doped carbon is rationally constructed to achieve the directional electronic modulation of active sites. The axial nitrogen ligand reconfigures the electronic distribution of Fe‐Mn heteronuclear sites, inducing Fe‐to‐Mn charge transfer and further charge localization on the Mn center. The electronic effect precisely modulates Mn d‐orbital energy levels, reinforcing the d‐p orbital hybridization between active sites and lithium polysulfides (LiPSs). The FeMn‐(N ax ) 2 DAC/NC strengthens the chemical adsorption of LiPSs to suppress the shuttle effect, and further bidirectionally accelerates the rate‐determining steps of sulfur redox: the solid‑to‑solid conversion from Li 2 S 2 to Li 2 S and the oxidative dissociation of Li 2 S. Consequently, the resultant sulfur cathodes deliver a discharge capacity of 682 mAh g − 1 at 5 C and an ultralow capacity decay rate of 0.047% per cycle over 1000 cycles at 3 C. This work offers a novel strategy for optimizing the redox kinetics of sulfur cathodes in Li‐S batteries.
papers.summary_ko: Fe-Mn 이원자 촉매(FeMn-(Nax)2 DAC/NC)에 이축 질소 배위 구조를 도입해 리튬-황 전지의 황 레독스 반응 속도를 향상시켰다. 축방향 질소 리간드가 Fe-Mn 이종원자 사이트 간 전하 이동을 유도해 Mn 중심에 전하가 국소화되고, 이는 Mn d-오비탈 에너지를 조절해 활성 사이트와 리튬 폴리설파이드 간의 d-p 오비탈 혼성화를 강화한다. 이를 통해 다황화리튬의 셔틀 효과를 억제하고 Li2S2에서 Li2S로의 고상 전환을 가속화해, 황 양극은 5C에서 682 mAh/g의 방전용량과 3C, 1000사이클에서 0.047%/사이클의 낮은 용량 감쇠율을 달성했다.

papers.title: Battery Electrode Engineering Enables Fast Charging LMFP Cells Without Carbon‐Coated Foil
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Lithium manganese iron phosphate (LiMn x Fe 1‐x PO 4 , LMFP) has emerged as a promising Li‐ion battery cathode material due to its high voltage, thermal stability, and cycle life, yet its intrinsically low electronic and ionic conductivity limits high‐rate performance and thus usefulness in fast‐charge applications such as electric vehicles. Here, we evaluate key electrode design aspects, investigating the interplay between calendering density and current collector priming (carbon‐coating) on the fast cycling performance of LMFP cathodes. For electrodes on pristine aluminium, calendering to high density induced particle embedment into the foil (quantified via segmentation of cross‐sectional microscope images), reducing interfacial resistance while enhancing both rate capability and long‐term cycling stability. In contrast, performance of electrodes on C‐coated aluminium exhibited minimal sensitivity to densification. Surprisingly, at sufficiently high calendering pressure (achieving density ≥ 2.5 g cm −3 ), the carbon coating provided no advantage to high‐rate performance, in stark contrast with conventional understanding, and cells manufactured with pristine Al achieved fast charging from 10% to 80% SOC in just over 15 min, a key milestone for this chemistry. These findings establish a mechanistic understanding of how density and interfacial properties govern transport and electrochemical behavior in LMFP cells, providing practical guidance for optimized electrode structures.
papers.summary_ko: LiMnxFe1-xPO4(LMFP) 양극의 고율 성능을 개선하기 위해 칼렌더링 밀도와 집전체 탄소코팅 간의 상호작용을 분석했다. 순수 알루미늄 집전체에서 고밀도 칼렌더링을 적용하면 입자가 포일에 박히며 계면저항이 낮아지고 고율 성능과 장기 사이클 안정성이 향상되는 반면, 탄소코팅 알루미늄은 밀도 변화에 둔감했다. 특히 밀도가 2.5 g/cm³ 이상일 때 탄소코팅의 이점이 사라지며, 순수 알루미늄 전극으로 10%에서 80% SOC까지 15분 이내의 급속충전을 달성했다.

papers.title: Flame Retardant Lithium Composites With Synergistic Suppression of Lithium Dendrites and Smoke Toxicity for High Safe Lithium Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Lithium metal batteries (LMBs) are regarded as the promising next‑generation high energy density storage, but their commercialization is hindered by uncontrolled Li dendrite growth and the persistent risk of thermal runaway. Herein, a multifunctional artificial interface membrane is designed through electrospinning combined with in situ metal‐organic framework (MOF) growth, aiming to construct a highly safe lithium metal anode. The uniformly dispersed MOF nanoparticles in the membrane generate uniform Li + flux through their inherent cage window structure, effectively inhibiting excessive Li dendrite formation and thereby stabilizing the lithium metal anode with improved cycling stability. Notably, the membrane exhibits strong adsorption and catalytic ability for hazardous CO gases released during thermal runaway, enabling valid conversion of CO to CO 2 . Importantly, the ignition time of the as‐prepared Li metal composite anode is significantly prolonged, providing a valuable time window for battery fire accident response and personnel rescue. This work demonstrates a multifunctionally flame retardant interface protective layer design method through integrated interfacial and rational material structure engineering. It leads to a new strategy for synergistic suppression of Li dendrites and smoke toxicity in future safe LMBs.
papers.summary_ko: 전기방사와 금속-유기 골격체(MOF)의 현장 성장을 결합해 리튬 금속 음극용 다기능 난연성 인공 보호막을 설계함. MOF 나노입자의 균일한 Li+ 플럭스 유도로 덴드라이트 성장을 억제하고 사이클 안정성을 개선하며, 열폭주 시 발생하는 유해 CO 가스를 CO2로 전환하고 발화 시간을 크게 연장시켜 리튬 금속 전지의 안전성을 동시에 확보함.

papers.title: Cascade Desolvation and Conversion Reaction Driven by Self‐Tandem Catalysis for Wide‐Temperature Li‐S Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Dissatisfactory electrochemical performance of wide‐temperature lithium‐sulfur batteries (LSBs) originates from the sluggish Li + desolvation and successive sulfur specie conversion kinetics at the interface and within the cathode interior. Herein, different from electrolyte engineering, a self‐tandem catalysis enabled cascade reactions is developed to drive Li + kinetics and associated polysulfide conversions in wide‐temperature LSBs. By incorporating electron‐adjustable atom‐level Ce as the self‐tandem catalyst onto defect‐rich Co, Fe‐based layered double hydroxides (EAAC@D‐LDH), a favorable solvation microenvironment is established to decrease the related barriers toward promoting rapid Li + desolvation, sulfur conversion, and Li 2 S delithiation kinetics, as revealed in Raman analysis, electrochemical evaluations, and ex‐situ interfacial morphology as well as composition characterization. Such improved reaction kinetics enable the sulfur cathodes work well in a wide temperature ranging from 0 to ‐30°C, and it retains high‐capacity retention of 94% at 5C. Under ‐20°C, the cells remain the capacity of 85% at 0.1C, respectively. Remarkably, a stable capacity is reserved even at an ultralow temperature of ‐30°C, demonstrating that the substantial promise of this self‐tandem catalysis supports cascade reaction refinement strategy toward high performance wide‐temperature LSBs.
papers.summary_ko: Co, Fe 기반 층상이중수산화물(LDH)에 전자구조 조절이 가능한 원자 수준의 Ce를 담지하여 셀프탠덤 촉매(EAAC@D-LDH)를 구현, 리튬-황 전지의 Li+ 탈솔베이션과 황종 전환 반응을 가속화했다. 이 촉매는 0~-30°C의 광범위한 온도 영역에서 황 양극의 반응속도론을 개선하여, -20°C·0.1C에서 85%, 5C에서 94%의 용량 유지율을 달성했다. -30°C의 극저온에서도 안정적인 용량이 유지됨을 입증했다.

papers.title: A multi-functionally integrated modular catalyst for efficient chemoselective hydrogenation
papers.abstract_en: Chemoselective hydrogenation of nitroarenes containing multiple reducible groups remains challenging due to the intrinsic activity–selectivity trade-off of conventional metal catalysts. Here we report a multi-functional Pt-based catalyst, modularly integrating molecular-sieving feedstock separation, hydrogen activation, intermediate transport and surface reaction like a nanofactory. Structurally, ~3 nm Pt nanoparticles supported on sodium titanate are encapsulated by oxygen vacancies-enriched TiOx overlayers that only permit hydrogen to adsorb on Pt particles for dissociation while preventing substrate contact. The generated active hydrogen species subsequently migrate to the catalyst surface and hydrogenate nitro groups adsorbed on surface Lewis basic oxygen vacancies, enabling an efficient condensation pathway while avoiding the use of corrosive and environmentally unfriendly alkaline solvents. The spatially decoupled yet functionally synergistic catalytic design achieves 90% 3-vinylaniline yield from 3-nitrostyrene under mild conditions with an unprecedented turnover frequency of 83,200 h−1, exceeding all previously reported metal catalysts, and exhibits broad generality toward diverse substituted nitroarenes. Collectively, these findings provide a powerful catalyst design strategy for steering complex reaction networks via spatially modular catalysis. Chemoselective hydrogenation of nitroarenes containing multiple reducible functional groups remains challenging because of the inherent activity–selectivity trade-off of conventional metal catalysts. Here, the authors report a multifunctional Pt-based catalyst that integrates molecular-sieving feedstock separation, hydrogen activation, intermediate transport, and surface reactions within a single catalytic system, enabling efficient chemoselective hydrogenation.

papers.title: Vacancy-Induced Ligand-Hole Character Redirects Oxygen Redox in Li-Rich Layered Oxides
papers.venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Li-rich layered oxides access high capacities through the combined participation of transition-metal and oxygen redox, but oxygen oxidation is often coupled with irreversible structural rearrangement and voltage decay. Here, we show that oxygen-vacancy-preconditioning modifies the local Ni–O electronic structure and promotes oxygen-derived ligand-hole character in a Li-rich layered oxide. High-temperature quasi-single-crystal (QSC) formation generates oxygen-deficient local environments while preserving the overall layered framework. Synchrotron spectroscopy combined with density functional theory (DFT) calculations reveals enhanced Ni–O hybridization and redistribution of charge compensation toward oxygen-derived states. Mapping resonant inelastic X-ray scattering further shows earlier oxygen participation during charging, followed by increased delocalization of oxygen-derived holes within hybridized transition-metal–oxygen states. This modified redox pathway suppresses Mn reduction and is coupled to a distinct structural response in which transient lattice environments formed during the initial cycle progressively relax during prolonged cycling, while the layered framework is largely retained. The resulting cathode exhibits reduced voltage hysteresis and voltage decay, together with improved electrochemical reversibility. These results establish a direct connection between vacancy-modified ligand-hole character and oxygen-redox-driven structural relaxation, demonstrating how local electronic structure governs the structural pathway of oxygen-redox-active layered oxides.
papers.summary_ko: 리튬 과잉 층상 산화물에서 산소 결함을 사전 유도해 Ni–O 전자구조를 조절하고 산소 유래 리간드-홀 특성을 유도하는 전략을 제시합니다. 고온 준단결정 합성으로 생성된 산소 결손 환경이 Ni–O 혼성화를 강화하고 충전 시 산소의 전하보상 참여를 앞당기며 Mn 환원을 억제함을 방사광 분광과 DFT로 규명했습니다. 이 경로에서는 초기 사이클의 과도 격자 구조가 점진적으로 이완되면서도 층상 구조가 유지되어 전압 히스테리시스와 전압 감쇠가 줄고 가역성이 향상됩니다.

papers.title: Super‐Toughness Self‐Healing Bimetallic MOF‐based Composite Solid Electrolyte with Nanoconfined Ion Channels and Dynamic Crosslinking for High‐Performance Solid‐State Lithium Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Solid‐state lithium metal batteries are considered ideal candidates for next‐generation energy storage systems due to high energy density and safety. However, NCM811||Li battery systems face severe issues in practical application, such as interface failure between the cathode and anode, lithium dendrite growth, and the insufficient stability of conventional electrolytes. Here, we proposed a synergistic modification strategy combined with nanoconfined polymerization and interface dynamic crosslinking to fabricate self‐healing bimetallic MOF‐based composite solid electrolyte with enhanced ionic conduction and interface stability. The as‐prepared electrolyte exhibits high room‐temperature ionic conductivity (12.63×10 −4 S cm − 1 ), extended electrochemical voltage windows (5.14 V), excellent elongation at break (270%), high puncture resistance (5.28 N), superior thermal stability (200 °C), and outstanding cycling stability (94.77% retention over 150 cycles at 0.1 C), which exceeds previously reported electrolytes. Even under high mass loadings of 9.24 mg cm − 2 and 20.38 mg cm − 2 for the cathode, the capacity retention rates can still reach 90.88% and 86.35% after 150 and 100 cycles, respectively, demonstrating practical potential under high‐loading conditions. This strategy reconstructs the Li + transport, interface stability, and recyclability of composite solid electrolytes at the molecular level, paving the way for the development of next‐generation high‐performance solid‐state batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 바이메탈 MOF 기반 복합 고체 전해질에 나노제한 중합과 계면 동적 가교를 결합해 자가치유 특성과 향상된 이온전도성, 계면 안정성을 구현했습니다. 실온 이온전도도 12.63×10⁻⁴ S/cm, 전기화학적 안정성 창 5.14 V, 신율 270%, 내천공성 5.28 N, 열안정성 200°C를 달성했으며 0.1C에서 150사이클 후 94.77%의 용량 유지율을 보였습니다. 고로딩 NCM811 양극(9.24, 20.38 mg/cm²)에서도 각각 150, 100사이클 후 90.88%, 86.35%의 용량 유지율을 나타내 고로딩 조건에서의 실용 가능성을 입증했습니다.

papers.title: Solvent‐Free Roll‐Pressed Sandwiched Li Anode With Dual‐Sided Cu Nanowire Networks for High‐Energy Lithium Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Li metal anodes are promising for next‐generation high‐energy batteries, but their practical use is hindered by dendritic Li growth, unstable interfaces, and large volume fluctuations. Herein, we report a bidirectional sandwich‐structured Li metal anode (SLA) fabricated through a solvent‐free rolling and pressing strategy. The SLA integrates an ultrathin Li layer with thermally stable 3D Cu nanowire networks on both sides, forming a lightweight, flexible, and mechanically robust electrode. The interconnected Cu nanowire framework provides continuous electron pathways, homogenizes current distribution, and accommodates Li volume changes, thereby guiding uniform Li deposition and stripping within the electrode interior. Benefiting from this design, the SLA achieves a high Coulombic efficiency of 98.73% over 250 cycles at 1 mA cm −2 and 1 mAh cm −2 , while symmetric cells operate stably for over 1350 h with low polarization. Full cells paired with high‐loading NCM811 cathodes deliver excellent cycling stability and rate capability. For a 4‐layer stacked pouch cell, the SLA‐based system delivers a gravimetric energy density of 279.11 Wh kg −1 and a volumetric energy density of 470.52 Wh L −1 , outperforming the PLA counterpart. This work provides a simple strategy for advancing stable Li metal anodes and high‐energy‐density Li metal batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 무용매 압연 공정으로 초박막 Li층 양면에 열적으로 안정한 3차원 Cu 나노와이어 네트워크를 적층한 샌드위치형 Li 금속 음극(SLA)을 제작했습니다. 상호연결된 Cu 나노와이어가 전자 경로를 제공하고 전류 분포를 균일화해 균일한 Li 증착·탈리를 유도함으로써 1 mA/cm², 1 mAh/cm² 조건에서 250사이클간 98.73%의 쿨롱효율과 대칭셀 1350시간 이상의 안정적 구동을 달성했습니다. 고로딩 NCM811 양극과 결합한 4층 파우치셀에서는 279.11 Wh/kg, 470.52 Wh/L의 에너지밀도를 구현하며 기존 구조 대비 우수한 성능을 보였습니다.

papers.title: Single-atom-doped zeolite electrolyte for quasi-solid-state zinc-iodine batteries
papers.abstract_en: Quasi-solid electrolytes can mitigate polyiodide shuttling and suppress parasitic reactions at zinc negative electrode in zinc-iodine batteries by reducing free water, but their limited liquid content often results in sluggish interfacial charge transfer. Here we show liquid-electrolyte-wetted quasi-solid electrolytes by combining single-atom-modified zeolites (single-atom = iron, cobalt, nickel, and copper) with zinc sulfate aqueous solution for high-rate zinc-iodine batteries. Theoretical calculations, in situ spectroscopy, and laser confocal microscopy reveal that the single-atom metal sites enhance iodine conversion kinetics and suppress polyiodide shuttling through a synergistic catalytic-adsorption effect, with iron-doped zeolite exhibiting the strongest performance. Iron-doped zeolite further stabilizes water molecules, suppresses side reactions, and promotes uniform zinc deposition. The iron-doped zeolite-assembled zinc-iodine batteries maintain a discharge capacity of 81.2 mAh g−1 (based on iodine mass) after 6,800 cycles at 4 A g−1, while proof-of-concept pouch cells exhibit a capacity of 147.6 mAh g−1 (based on iodine mass) or 52 mAh g−1 (based on total positive electrode mass) after 200 cycles at 0.5 A g−1. Lastly, iron-doped zeolite also demonstrates compatibility with other positive electrode materials for rechargeable zinc batteries. Quasi-solid zinc iodine batteries face sluggish kinetics due to low liquid content. Here, authors report single-atom metal-doped zeolite electrolytes that simultaneously catalyze iodine conversion, suppress polyiodide shuttling, and stabilize zinc deposition, achieving 6,800 stable cycles at high rates and demonstrating proof-of-concept pouch-cell performance.
papers.summary_ko: 아연-요오드 전지에서 폴리요오드 셰틀링과 부반응을 줄이기 위해 단일원자(Fe, Co, Ni, Cu)로 개질한 제올라이트를 황산아연 수계 전해질과 결합한 액체함침형 준고체 전해질을 제안했습니다. 이론계산과 현장 분광, 레이저 공초점 현미경을 통해 단일원자 금속 활성점이 촉매-흡착 상승효과로 요오드 전환 속도를 높이고 셰틀링을 억제함을 확인했으며 Fe 도핑 제올라이트가 가장 우수한 성능을 보였습니다. Fe 도핑 제올라이트 적용 전지는 4 A/g에서 6800사이클 후 81.2 mAh/g(요오드 기준)의 방전용량을 유지했고 파우치셀에서도 0.5 A/g, 200사이클 후 147.6 mAh/g(요오드 기준)의 용량을 보였습니다.

papers.title: Mineral Particle Suspensions in Carbonate Electrolyte Enable LiF‐Rich Interphases for Durable Lithium Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT The solid electrolyte interphase in lithium metal batteries determines cycling stability but often suffers from the incomplete decomposition of fluorinated components. Herein, we demonstrate that suspending LiF and Li 2 O particles in a carbonate‐based electrolyte promotes the defluorination of fluoroethylene carbonate and lithium hexafluorophosphate. These particles preferentially adsorb fluorinated electrolyte species and induce electronic polarization, thereby modulating their redox reactivity and facilitating interfacial decomposition toward LiF. The generated LiF, together with the trace dissolution and interfacial reprecipitation of suspended LiF particles, continuously enriches the electrode surface with LiF‐rich inorganic species. This process results in the formation of a bilayer interphase on both the lithium metal anode and LiNi 0.6 Co 0.2 Mn 0.2 O 2 cathode, featuring a flexible inner layer and a dense LiF‐rich outer layer. The resulting interphase suppresses lithium dendrites, mitigates parasitic reactions, and enables 2400 h of stable cycling in symmetric cells and 85.6% capacity retention after 400 cycles in full cells. By introducing suspended LiF/Li 2 O particles to regulate the interfacial decomposition of fluorinated electrolyte species, this work provides an effective electrolyte‐design strategy for constructing robust interphases in lithium metal batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 탄산염 전해질에 LiF와 Li2O 입자를 분산시켜 플루오로에틸렌카보네이트와 LiPF6의 탈플루오르화를 촉진하는 전략을 제시했습니다. 이 입자들이 불소화 전해질 성분을 선택적으로 흡착하고 전자 분극을 유도해 계면에 LiF가 풍부하게 생성되도록 하며, 생성된 LiF와 입자의 재용해·재석출이 결합되어 Li 금속 음극과 LiNi0.6Co0.2Mn0.2O2 양극 양쪽에 유연한 내층과 치밀한 LiF 풍부 외층으로 구성된 이중층 계면을 형성합니다. 이 계면은 Li 덴드라이트를 억제하고 부반응을 완화해 대칭셀에서 2400시간의 안정적 사이클링과 완전셀에서 400사이클 후 85.6%의 용량 유지율을 달성했습니다.

papers.title: An integrated cathode-electrolyte architecture with Cu dual active-sites for all-solid-state Li–CO2 batteries
papers.abstract_en: All-solid-state Li–CO2 batteries are limited by sluggish interfacial CO2 redox kinetics and the incomplete decomposition of insulating Li2CO3 at rigid solid-solid-gas interfaces. Here, we report an integrated cathode-electrolyte architecture in which copper atomic clusters and single atoms are co-anchored on freestanding N-doped carbon nanotubes and coupled with a succinonitrile/Li1+xAlyGe2-y(PO4)3-based solid-state electrolyte. The conformal ion-conducting phase and conductive nanotube scaffold provide coupled pathways for Li+, electrons and CO2 at the cathode interface. Electronic coupling between the copper atomic clusters and single atoms induces charge transfer from the former to the latter (~0.457 e−), rendering the Cu cluster sites partially cationic and facilitating the activation of carbonate intermediates. This dual-site configuration changes the discharge pathway and lowers the reaction energy of the rate-determining step to 2.412 eV. The assembled battery delivers a discharge capacity of 21356 mAh g−1 at 200 mA g−1 and operates for 260 cycles (>1000 h) at 500 mA g−1 with an energy efficiency of 78%. This work provides an interfacial design strategy for solid-state Li–CO2 batteries by coupling continuous transport pathways with electronically regulated dual Cu active sites. Stimuli responsive assemblies can offer precise control over behaviour, but use of gases for this control is rare. Here, the authors report the use of carbon dioxide for tuneable nanoparticle response, directed by changes in peptide structure.
papers.summary_ko: 전고체 Li–CO2 전지를 위해 Cu 원자클러스터와 단일원자를 질소도핑 탄소나노튜브에 공동 고정하고 숙시노나이트릴/LAGP 기반 고체전해질과 결합한 일체형 양극-전해질 구조를 제시했습니다. Cu 클러스터에서 단일원자로의 전하이동(~0.457 e⁻)이 탄산염 중간체의 활성화를 촉진해 반응 경로를 바꾸고 속도결정단계의 반응에너지를 2.412 eV로 낮춥니다. 이 전지는 200 mA/g에서 21356 mAh/g의 방전용량을 보였고 500 mA/g에서 260사이클(1000시간 이상) 동안 78%의 에너지효율로 작동했습니다.

papers.title: Weak-Solvating Carboxylate Ester Electrolyte Enables Hybrid Interphase via Cooperative Additives toward Wide-Temperature Sodium Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Fast Na+ transport and durable interfacial stability remain challenging for wide-temperature Na- metal batteries. To address these issues, we developed a synergistic solvation-interphase regulation strategy by integrating methyl propanoate (MP) with a combined VC/NaDFOB additive pair. MP modifies the Na+ solvation sheath and facilitates Na+ desolvation, while VC and NaDFOB cooperatively generate a mechanically robust hybrid organicinorganic interphase. This coupled regulation enables enhanced ion transport and interfacial stability over a broad temperature range. The EC/EMC/MP + VC/NaDFOB electrolyte exhibits an ionic conductivity of 2.52 mS cm–1 at –40 ̊C and an increased Na+ transference number. Na||Na3V2(PO4)3 cells retain 96.5% of their initial capacity after 1000 cycles with an average Coulombic efficiency of 99.98% at room temperature. At –20 ̊C, the cells deliver 69.4 mAh g–1 for over 900 cycles, corresponding to 82% of their room-temperature capacity. This work establishes a practical solvation-interphase regulation approach for wide-temperature Na- metal batteries.

papers.title: Quantifying Sodium Metal SEI Dissolution and Relation to Corrosion Using Quartz Crystal Microbalance
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Sodium-metal batteries present a more abundant alternative to lithium-based batteries, with high theoretical capacity and comparable reduction potential. Ether electrolytes perform well in sodium-metal batteries under continuous cycling and are presumed to have a stable solid-electrolyte interphase (SEI). However, the solubility of sodium SEI components is a cause for concern, and SEI evolution during calendar aging is not commonly studied for the ether sodium-metal system. In this work, SEI mass formation and dissolution are quantitatively measured for NaPF6 in diglyme. For varying potential hold levels, significant SEI dissolution is observed, from 55 to 76% of the originally formed SEI. Characterization shows that in addition to organic component dissolution, inorganic salts such as NaF and NaxPOyFz are unstable in SEI during open circuit rest. This instability results in continuous corrosion of sodium metal during calendar aging, highlighting an important understanding and concern of SEI stability in sodium-metal batteries.

papers.title: Tracing and Healing Multiscale Defects for Cost‐Effective Lithium Carbonate‐Derived Layered Oxide Cathodes
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Lithium carbonate (LC) is markedly cheaper than lithium hydroxide (LH) but remains underused for layered oxide cathodes because LC‐derived materials perform poorly. Here, using a mid‐Ni cathode, LiNi 0.65 Co 0.05 Mn 0.30 O 2 (N65), we trace this performance gap to LC‐induced defects that span length scales, from atomic‐scale disorder to nanoscale and microscale porosity. These defects originate from three features of the carbonate pathway that act across the solid, liquid, and gas phases, namely decoupled dehydration and lithiation, late melting of the carbonate, and a locally oxygen‐deficient atmosphere from evolving CO 2 . Guided by this picture, we heal the defects with a single secondary heat treatment (SH) that adds an optimized amount of LH, simultaneously replenishing lithium, restoring an oxidizing atmosphere, and densifying the structure. The resulting N65‐LC SH achieves discharge capacity, rate capability, and cycling stability comparable to those of the LH counterpart, while cutting the lithium precursor cost by 9% to 16% relative to conventional all‐LH synthesis. More broadly, the gap between LH and LC is not an intrinsic property of the carbonate but a consequence of a precursor‐specific pathway that, once traced, can be engineered around to unlock low‐cost, high‐performance Ni‐based layered oxide cathodes.

papers.title: Thermodynamic Suppression of Deprotonation in Succinonitrile‐Based Electrolyte for Durable Solid‐State Sodium‐Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Solid‐state sodium‐metal batteries (SSMBs) offer a low‐cost, safe, and high‐energy‐density energy‐storage technology. While succinonitrile (SN) is widely adopted in solid and gel electrolytes for its high dielectric constant, exceptional oxidative stability, and robust cathode compatibility, its practical application is limited by parasitic reactions with Na metal, including deprotonation and polymerization. Herein, we demonstrated a thermodynamic suppression strategy of deprotonation that substantially inhibits parasitic reactions in SN‐based electrolytes for durable SSMBs. By utilizing an acrylonitrile (AN) based polymer as the host framework, we establish an optimized interaction with free SN that thermodynamically disfavors the parasitic decomposition, effectively stabilizing the α‐hydrogens of the methylene groups against deprotonation. The rationally designed electrolyte exhibits high ionic conductivity of 2.17 mS cm −1 and exceptional compatibility with Na metal, enabling stable cycling of Na | Na symmetric cells for 6200 h. Na | Vanadium phosphate sodium full cells retain 95.6% capacity after 5000 cycles at 1.0 C, 93.4% after 10000 cycles at 2.0 C, and pouch cells with an ultra‐high cathode loading of 20 mg cm −2 demonstrate stable performance. This work establishes thermodynamic suppression of deprotonation as a foundational design principle for high‐energy‐density and long‐lifespan SSMBs.

papers.title: Oxyhalide‐Derived Nb‐O‐Cl Interfacial Frameworks for Mitigating Oxygen‐Related Degradation and Facilitating Li + Transport in High‐Voltage Ni‐Rich Cathodes
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT High‐voltage Ni‐rich cathodes coupled with sulfide solid electrolytes suffer from coupled instability of highly oxidized Ni‐O configurations and Li + transport discontinuity under deep delithiation. Conventional oxide coatings mainly act as passive barrier layers that separate reactive contacts but remain structurally isolated from layered cathodes without simultaneously regulating interfacial chemistry and Li + transport. Here, we report an oxyhalide‐enabled interfacial chemistry strategy based on a reconstructive Nb‐O‐Cl framework on LiNi 0.83 Co 0.07 Mn 0.10 O 2 cathodes (denoted as C‐NCM). Derived from a mixed‐anion LiNbOCl 4 (LNOC) precursor, the Nb‐O‐Cl framework undergoes mechanochemically assisted interfacial reconstruction, forming an amorphous oxyhalide interphase coupled with a Nb‐containing near‐surface region. Unlike passive oxide barriers, this chemically integrated architecture simultaneously reshapes the local Ni‐O electronic environment and mediates interface‐crossing Li + transport. Nb‐O/Nb‐O‐Cl coordination redistributes local charge and is associated with improved retention of highly oxidized Ni‐O configurations and mitigated oxygen‐related irreversible evolution, while the Cl‐containing oxyhalide framework provides an ionically conductive transition region that facilitates Li + migration across the cathode/electrolyte interface. Accordingly, C‐NCM exhibits reduced sulfide‐derived interphase formation and slower resistance growth, together with 88.17% capacity retention after 500 cycles at 4.5 V under high cathode loading. This work shifts cathode/sulfide‐electrolyte interface design from passive oxide‐barrier protection toward reconstructive mixed‐anion interfacial chemistry.

papers.title: Determining depth-resolved spatial distribution of solid–electrolyte interphase using non-destructive angle-resolved X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy for lithium-metal batteries
papers.abstract_en: The solid electrolyte interphase is a key performance regulator in Li-metal batteries, which are regarded as an important technology for future energy storage. Understanding this crucial interphase through non-destructive analysis is essential to advance the performance and lifespan of Li-metal batteries. We introduce angle-resolved X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy as a non-destructive technique for the depth-profile analysis of the solid electrolyte interphase in Li-metal batteries. Importantly, we show that this characterization technique displays a distinct advantage in preserving the solid electrolyte interphase's integrity compared to traditional sputtering-based depth-profiling. Our findings add to the understanding of compositional differences in the solid electrolyte interphase before the onset of Li electrodeposition and after Li plating. Moreover, we find significant variations in the thickness and distribution of solid electrolyte interphase species across different classes of electrolytes, which strongly influence the solid electrolyte interphase's protective properties and, by extension, Li-metal battery performance. This study benchmarks the application of angle-resolved X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy in revealing detailed, depth-resolved chemical composition of the solid electrolyte interphase in a non-destructive approach. Understanding the solid–electrolyte interphase formed on lithium is vital for improving the lifetime of lithium metal batteries. Here, authors show that angle-resolved X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy can reveal the depth-dependent composition of the interfacial layer without damaging it by ion sputtering.

papers.title: Decoupling Li + Transport in Self‐Healing Polymer Dual‐Salt Electrolytes for Room Temperature Lithium Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Gel polymer electrolytes (GPEs) stand as leading candidates for advancing high‐energy‐density lithium metal batteries toward next‐generation applications. However, the inherent crystallinity of conventional polymer matrices severely limits ionic conductivity (IC) and Li + transference number (t Li + ), while imposing large interfacial resistance and uncontrollable lithium dendrite growth—critical bottlenecks hindering practical room‐temperature application. Herein, we report a dual‐salt incorporation strategy within a self‐curing polymer framework to overcome these challenges. The anion‐anion interactions of the dual‐salt system within the polymer network immobilize the anions, thereby liberating a greater number Li + ions. Additionally, the salt‐polymer interactions alter the polymer energy levels, cooperatively enhancing the IC to 2.23 mS cm −1 and the t Li + to 0.55. The electrolyte sustains stable Li||Li symmetric cycling for over 2000 h. When integrated with a LiFePO 4 cathode, the full cell delivers 133 mAh g 1 at 1C with 75% capacity retention over 700 cycles, while the NMC811||Li cell achieves 135 mAh g −1 , retaining 72% of its initial capacity over 250 cycles. Additionally, the electrolyte exhibits inherent flame retardancy and uniform Li + plating‐stripping, effectively suppressing dendrite penetration. This design strategy provides a viable route to ambient‐temperature, self‐curing GPEs that enhance battery safety and suppress dead lithium.

papers.title: An untethered sub-gram flapping-wing flight system achieves sustained self-stabilizing and altitude-controlled flight
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Insect-scale flapping-wing micro aerial vehicles offer substantial potential for applications such as search and rescue. However, stringent power and payload constraints at the sub-gram scale have precluded sustained untethered flight. Inspired by the high lift generated by full-circumferential rotor motion, this study presents a cross-shaped piezoelectric direct-drive V-wing structure. The structure uses a tuning-fork vibration mode to generate full-circumferential flapping, suppressing fuselage vibration without external anchoring and substantially improving the lift performance of the piezoelectric direct-drive flapping-wing micro aerial vehicle. Based on this principle, we developed a cross-shaped four-piezoelectric-actuator V-wing micro aerial vehicle weighing 389 mg with a wingspan of 6.8 cm, capable of generating a maximum lift of 1850 mg. Waveform modulation increases the efficiency of the 173 mg drive circuit to 45%, while mechanical self-stabilization suppresses attitude disturbances. Integrated with a 350 mg battery, the 984 mg system achieves untethered, sustained, stable flight for a sub-gram flapping-wing micro aerial vehicle. The maximum lift-to-weight ratio of the untethered flapping-wing micro aerial vehicle system is 1.88. Its maximum flight altitude exceeds 10 m, and its continuous flight duration under low-power operation exceeds 240 s. The system also demonstrates altitude-controlled and disturbance-resilient untethered flight.

papers.title: A Tailored Multifunctional Lithium Organosilicate Salt Constructing Robust Interphases for High Voltage Lithium Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Lithium metal batteries (LMBs) have attracted extensive attention due to their high energy density. However, when lithium (Li) metal is paired with high‐voltage cathode materials, its practical application is limited by issues such as continuous oxidative decomposition of electrolytes and the incompatibility between electrolytes and aggressive electrodes. Herein, we synthesize a fluorinated lithium organosilicate salt (i.e., lithium fluorobis(fluoropinacolatoborato)silicate, LiPBS) to address the aforementioned challenges. The results show that the LiPBS can form a protective and rigid‐flexible cathode electrolyte interphase (CEI) on the cathode surface. Simultaneously, PBS − readily forms a coordination ion pair (CIP) with Li + , constructing an inorganic‐rich solid electrolyte interphase (SEI) on the Li anode. Furthermore, Si─O groups in the LiPBS can effectively scavenge HF and H 2 O from the electrolyte. These advantageous properties enable LiCoO 2 (LCO, 1.89 mAh cm −2 )/Li (50 µm) coin and pouch cells to exhibit excellent cycling performance at high voltages and elevated rates‒for example, retaining 82% capacity after 250 cycles at 1 C and 4.5 V, compared to 80% retention after only 67 cycles for the LiPF 6 ‐based counterpart. This performance is maintained even at an elevated temperature of 50°C. This work highlights the crucial role of lithium organosilicate salt in determining the electrochemical performance of LMBs.

papers.title: Strain-engineered fabrication of high-density aligned graphene-based nanoscrolls via UV-tunable adhesive tapes
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Graphene nanoscrolls (GNSs), one-dimensional nanostructures formed by rolling up a single sheet of graphene, exhibit electronic and mechanical properties distinct from the original graphene sheet. Although several methods have been proposed to synthesize GNSs, achieving high-density GNSs with controlled scroll chirality and direction remains challenging. Here, we demonstrate the strain-engineered fabrication of large-scale GNSs using an ultraviolet (UV) light-tunable adhesive tape. The UV tape is stretched to apply tensile strain to graphene stacked on it, and releasing the applied strain by detaching the graphene from the tape results in the formation of GNSs. This strain-assisted method gives isolated GNSs of increased density ( ≈ 380 nanoscrolls per mm) and length (90 μm). This method also allows control of the scroll angle, i.e., chiral angle, by controlling the stretch direction of the tape/graphene stack. The nanoscroll structure allows the intercalation of metal chloride molecules, resulting in an increase of the electrical conductivity. Furthermore, heteronanoscrolls of graphene and MoS 2 are realized by stretching MoS 2 /graphene heterostacks, exhibiting clear optical response. Our controlled synthesis of GNSs and heteronanoscrolls provides an opportunity to manipulate nanomaterials through the strain engineering with the functional UV tape.

papers.title: Orbital coupling effect enables low-chloride concentration electrolyte for four-electron redox in aqueous zinc | |iodine batteries
papers.abstract_en: The I-/I0/I+ redox chemistry is hindered by the inherent instability of the electrophilic I+, which undergoes hydrolysis in aqueous media or is rapidly consumed by comproportionation with triiodide ions. Here, we design a copper single-atom embedded nitrogen-doped carbon host that synergistically combines d-p orbital hybridization and local low-concentration chloride ions to stabilize the I+. The atomic Cu-Nx sites interact moderately with iodine species through Cu d- and I p-orbital hybridization, which enhances iodine species adsorption, accelerates redox kinetics, and increases the hydrolysis energy barrier of I+. Simultaneously, the Cu-Nx sites promote a localized I-Cl microenvironment through electrostatic interaction, enabling efficient I0/I+ conversion even in a low-concentration Cl- ion electrolyte. As a result, the assembled zinc | |iodine battery exhibits a distinct four-electron dual-voltage plateau, achieving a high capacity of ~408 mAh g−1 at 1 A g−1. Even at a high specific current of 10 A g−1, the cell exhibits a high initial capacity of ~251 mAh g−1 and maintains a capacity retention of 70% with a low decay rate of 0.0062‰ per cycle over 50,000 cycles. This work provides a rational design method for coupling single-atom catalysis with localized ion confinement to realize high-voltage and long-life iodine conversion chemistry. Aqueous zinc | |iodine batteries suffer from irreversible iodine conversion and hydrolysis. Here, the authors design a copper single-atom porous carbon host that enables reversible four-electron I⁻/I⁰/I⁺ conversion for stable cycling.
papers.summary_ko: 수계 아연-요오드 전지에서 불안정한 I+ 중간체를 안정화하기 위해 구리 단일원자가 삽입된 질소 도핑 탄소 호스트를 설계했다. Cu-Nx 사이트의 d-p 오비탈 혼성화와 국소 저농도 염소 이온 환경이 I+의 가수분해를 억제하고 4전자 I-/I0/I+ 반응을 가능하게 한다. 이를 통해 1 A/g에서 약 408 mAh/g의 용량과 50,000회 사이클에서 70%의 용량 유지율을 달성했다.

papers.title: Lipids intercalate and mediate multi-channel assemblies of connexin-46/50 gap junctions
papers.abstract_en: Gap junction channels enable direct electrical and metabolic exchange between adjacent cells and organize into plaques containing tens to thousands of channels. Although plaque formation modulates junctional conductance, the structural basis for channel–channel organization remains poorly defined. Here, we reconstitute native lens connexin-46/50 (Cx46/50) channels into MSP-based lipid nanodiscs containing multiple channels and determine high-resolution structures of dual-channel assemblies in two configurations. The interfaces lack extensive protein–protein contacts and instead contain ordered lipid densities that define much of the inter-channel interface. These interfaces stabilize discrete lipid populations, including an interstitial lipid near the N-terminal gating domain, suggesting how channel organization may promote lipid occupancy near the pore. We also refine the Cx46/50 single-channel structure to 1.8 Å, providing an internal reference and chemical detail of the stabilized open-state. Together, these results define lipid-rich interfaces as a feature of multi-channel organization and suggest how plaque-like packing may tune gap junction function. Gap junction channels assemble into plaques that coordinate communication across tissues. Here, authors show how neighboring Cx46/50 channels pack within membranes and identify ordered lipids as major components of their interfaces
papers.summary_ko: 렌즈의 connexin-46/50(Cx46/50) 간극연접 채널을 지질 나노디스크에 재구성하여 다중 채널 조립체의 고해상도 구조를 규명했다. 채널 간 계면은 단백질-단백질 접촉이 거의 없고 정렬된 지질이 상호작용을 매개하며, 단일 채널 구조는 1.8Å 해상도로 정제했다. 이를 통해 플라크형 채널 패킹이 간극연접 기능을 조절하는 방식을 제시했다.

papers.title: Kinetic acceleration of phosphate remediation in dilute aquatic environments via photovoltaic-driven solid-state electrolyte electrocoagulation
papers.abstract_en: The kinetic limitations of reclaiming low-level orthophosphate (PO43−) in low-conductivity natural water bodies impede the in-depth remediation of anthropogenic eutrophication. Conventional adsorption and electrocoagulation (EC) methods are hindered by excessive chemical reagent consumption, high electrical energy demand, and substantial metal electrode consumption. Here, we present a solid-state electrolyte electrocoagulation (SEE) system that employs an interfacial coupling strategy to integrate dynamic ion enrichment with in situ anodic coagulation. By concentrating PO43− at the solid-state electrolyte interface, the system overcomes inherent mass-transport constraints and enhances ion conductivity in dilute media. This localized concentration gradient accelerates apparent reaction kinetics, achieving a removal rate of 0.197 mg/L·min, minimizing energy consumption to 0.0325 kWh/g P and iron consumption to 3.829 g/g P. Consequently, SEE enables efficient, one-step purification below strict regulatory thresholds ( ≤ 0.02 mg/L, China’s Class I Surface Water Environmental Quality Standard). Validated as a photovoltaic-integrated, boat-mounted unit, this approach offers a robust decentralized solution for natural waters, with techno-economic and life cycle assessments confirming its economic viability and low environmental footprint. A solar-powered electrocoagulation system rapidly removes low-level phosphate from natural waters via interfacial ion concentration, overcoming mass-transfer limits for efficient decentralized water purification with low energy and material use.
papers.summary_ko: 저농도 인산염(PO4^3-) 제거를 위해 광전지로 구동되는 고체전해질 전기응집(SEE) 시스템을 제안했다. 고체전해질 계면에서 PO4^3-를 농축시켜 물질전달 한계를 극복하고 반응 속도를 높여 0.197 mg/L·min의 제거율과 낮은 에너지·철 소모량을 달성했다. 태양광 연동 보트 탑재형 시스템으로 검증하여 중국 I급 수질 기준 이하로 정화 가능함을 보였다.

papers.title: Ionic Microenvironment Regulator Enables Enhanced Anion Trapping in Cationic Poly(Ionic Liquid) Solid Electrolyte for Low‐Temperature Lithium Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Despite the considerable promise of solid polymer electrolytes (SPEs) for enabling high‐energy‐density and intrinsically safe lithium metal batteries, their practical deployment in cold environments remains hindered by sluggish Li + transport at sub‐zero temperatures. Herein, methyl trifluoromethanesulfonate (TMS) is introduced as an ionic microenvironment regulator into a cationic poly(ionic liquid) solid electrolyte, enabling enhanced Li + transport under extreme low‐temperature conditions. Notably, TMS not only enhances lithium salt dissociation but also induces an anion‐trapping effect by modulating the local charge distribution of the polycationic backbone, thereby facilitating uniform lithium deposition. As a result, the optimized cationic poly(ionic liquid) solid electrolyte (PIL‐TMS 1 ) enables stable cryogenic operation of high‐voltage Li||PIL‐TMS 1 ||LiNi 0.8 Co 0.1 Mn 0.1 O 2 and Li||PIL‐TMS 1 ||LiFePO 4 batteries, delivering capacity retentions of 89.8% after 500 cycles and 80.1% after 800 cycles at −15°C, respectively. This work presents an effective strategy for designing low‐temperature solid‐state lithium metal batteries through additive‐regulated anion trapping and accelerated Li + transport.
papers.summary_ko: 저온에서 고체 고분자 전해질의 Li+ 전달 속도 저하 문제를 해결하기 위해 양이온성 폴리(이온성 액체) 고체전해질에 메틸 트리플루오로메탄술포네이트(TMS)를 이온성 미세환경 조절제로 도입했다. TMS는 리튬염 해리를 촉진하고 음이온 포집 효과를 유도하여 균일한 리튬 전착을 가능하게 한다. 그 결과 −15°C에서 Li||NCM811 전지는 500회 후 89.8%, Li||LFP 전지는 800회 후 80.1%의 용량 유지율을 보였다.

papers.title: Interface‐Mediated Architectural Engineering of Silicon for Solid‐State Batteries: Current Status and Future Outlook
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Solid‐state lithium batteries promise superior performance and enhanced safety over current lithium‐ion batteries. As lithium metal encounters intrinsic challenges, high‐capacity silicon anodes have gained increasing attention to satisfy the growing demand for higher energy density and safety. However, the commercialization of such systems is impeded by challenges including large volume variation, poor interfacial contact, sluggish charge transport, inferior performance, and excessive pressure reliance. This review discusses fundamental challenges and interface‐mediated architectural engineering strategies. Based on the coupling mode of silicon and solid electrolyte, the developed architectures are classified into three representative categories, with emphasis on their design principles, multiscale construction methodologies, and enhancement mechanisms. In light of the latest advances, this review systematizes the architectural paradigms, and clarifies the synergistic correlations between interfacial compatibility, electron and ion transport, stress relaxation, and side reactions between silicon and solid electrolyte. Scalable manufacturing protocols and sustainable monitoring approaches are then delineated toward practical applications. Finally, the review summarizes the advantages and disadvantages of these classifications and outlines future directions for advancing stable, safe, scalable, and sustainable silicon‐based electrode technologies for viable solid‐state batteries with enhanced energy density, power capability, durability, and manufacturability at low‐pressure operation.
papers.summary_ko: 고용량 실리콘 음극을 전고체 배터리에 적용하기 위한 계면 매개 구조 설계 전략을 정리한 리뷰 논문이다. 실리콘과 고체전해질의 결합 방식에 따라 구조를 세 가지로 분류하고 설계 원리, 다중 스케일 구축 방법, 성능 향상 기전을 논의했다. 대면적 제조 공정과 저압 작동을 위한 향후 연구 방향도 제시했다.

papers.title: Functional Separator Coatings for Lithium/Sodium Metal Batteries: Bridging Academic Research and Industrial Prospects
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Lithium/sodium metal batteries (LSMBs) are promising candidates for next‐generation high‐energy‐density storage, yet their practical deployment remains constrained by dendrite formation, unstable electrode‐electrolyte interfaces, and safety risks. Functional separator coatings offer an attractive strategy for stabilizing metal anodes because they are compatible with existing battery manufacturing and can be readily integrated into cell designs. This review provides a comprehensive overview of the evolution from conventional polyolefin‐based separators to advanced functional architectures. The physicochemical mechanisms through which functional coatings regulate ion transport, homogenize metal deposition, suppress dendrite growth, and improve thermal stability are critically reviewed. Representative coating materials, including ceramics, polymers, carbonaceous materials, metal‐organic frameworks, and hybrid systems, are discussed in terms of their structure‐function relationships, advantages, and limitations. The scalability of different coating strategies is evaluated in terms of coating thickness, line speed/throughput, material utilization, equipment requirements, and process continuity, thereby facilitating the selection of appropriate fabrication routes for distinct application scenarios. Finally, key challenges and future directions are outlined to guide rational separator design and practical manufacturing. This review aims to provide mechanistic insights and design principles for translating functional coated separators toward commercially viable metal batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 리튬/소듐 금속 배터리의 덴드라이트 형성과 전극-전해질 계면 불안정성을 해결하기 위한 기능성 분리막 코팅 전략을 정리한 리뷰 논문이다. 세라믹, 고분자, 탄소계, MOF 등 다양한 코팅 소재가 이온 전달 조절, 금속 증착 균일화, 덴드라이트 억제에 미치는 메커니즘을 다루었다. 코팅 두께, 공정 속도, 소재 활용률 등 산업적 확장성 관점에서도 각 전략을 평가했다.

papers.title: Fluorine-Mediated Molten-Salt Crystallization Regulates Phase Evolution and Structural Stability in Sodium Layered Oxides
papers.venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Ni- and Co-free P2-type Fe–Mn layered oxides with high Na concentrations are promising cathodes for sodium-ion batteries, but their practical use is limited by phase instability during Na-excess synthesis and structural degradation during cycling and storage. Although large single-crystal-like architectures could improve stability, controlled phase-selective crystallization in these cathode systems remains challenging. Here, we show that fluorine-assisted molten-salt synthesis enables controlled formation of large-particle Fe–Mn–Ti P2 cathodes with enhanced phase selectivity and structural coherence. Compared with Na-excess processing alone, NaF-assisted flux growth expands the P2 phase stability window and promotes large particles with uniform morphologies while preserving local layered ordering. Multiscale characterization further reveals more-reversible structural evolution and more homogeneous Mn redox behavior in the NaF-assisted material, together with a gradient-like fluorine distribution involving surface-enriched NaF-like species and lower level interior fluorine environments. These coupled structural, morphological, and chemical features collectively mitigate crack formation and deliver good cycling stability. In summary, NaF-assisted molten-salt synthesis shows promise in addressing key limitations of Ni- and Co-free P2-type Fe–Mn layered cathodes.
papers.summary_ko: Ni, Co가 없는 P2형 Fe-Mn 층상 소듐 양극재는 높은 Na 농도에서 상 불안정성과 구조 저하 문제를 겪는다. 불소 보조 용융염 합성법을 통해 NaF를 이용해 P2 상 안정성 영역을 넓히고 균일한 형상의 대형 Fe-Mn-Ti P2 입자를 성장시켰다. 표면에 NaF 유사 불소종이 농축된 구배 분포가 균열 형성을 억제하여 우수한 사이클 안정성을 보였다.

papers.title: Electron Localization at In‐on‐Li Antisites Enables High‐Current‐Density Compatibility of Chloride Solid Electrolytes with Lithium Metal
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Lithium‐metal all‐solid‐state batteries offer a pathway toward high‐specific‐energy storage but remain limited by instability at the solid‐state electrolyte (SSE)/Li interface. Fluorinated chloride solid electrolytes exhibit improved kinetic stability toward Li metal at low current densities (≤0.2 mA cm −2 ), but become increasingly susceptible to electron injection at high current densities (≥1 mA cm −2 ), leading to sustained reductive decomposition and interfacial degradation. Here, we develop LiCl‑deficient Li 3‑x InCl 5.2‑x F 0.8 solid electrolytes to regulate interfacial electron transport. LiCl deficiency generates Li vacancies preferentially at 4 g sites and lowers the barrier for In migration into these vacancies, thereby forming In‐on‐Li antisites. These antisite‐centered defect environments serve as electron‐localization centers that trap injected electrons, suppress long‐range electronic transport, and inhibit the reduction of In 3+ to metallic In. This electron‐localization mechanism promotes a self‐passivating interphase and markedly improves high‐current‐density compatibility with Li metal. The optimized Li 2.76 InCl 4.96 F 0.8 composition exhibits an ionic conductivity of 1.24 mS cm −1 , stable Li plating/stripping at 1.0–1.5 mA cm −2 , and durable full‐cell cycling with LiNi 0.6 Co 0.2 Mn 0.2 O 2 (NCM622) cathodes at 1 mA cm −2 . These findings establish LiCl‐deficiency‐induced electron localization as an atomic‐scale electronic regulation strategy for enabling high‐current‐density compatibility between chloride solid electrolytes and Li‐metal anodes, thereby advancing the development of high‐specific‐energy all‐solid‐state lithium‐metal batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 염화물 고체전해질은 고전류 밀도에서 전자 주입에 취약해 리튬 금속과의 계면 안정성이 저하된다. LiCl이 부족한 Li3-xInCl5.2-xF0.8 조성을 설계하여 In이 Li 자리로 이동하는 In-on-Li 안티사이트를 형성, 주입된 전자를 국소화해 In3+ 환원을 억제했다. 최적 조성 Li2.76InCl4.96F0.8은 1.24 mS/cm의 이온 전도도와 1.0-1.5 mA/cm²에서 안정적인 Li 도금/탈리, NCM622 완전셀에서의 내구성을 보였다.

papers.title: Synergistic Effects of Separator Architecture and Electrolyte Chemistry on the Electrochemical Stability of Lithium Ion Batteries With Li–Mn Rich Cathodes and µ‐Si Anodes
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT High‐voltage, high‐capacity lithium ion batteries (LIBs) combining cobalt‐free lithium manganese‐rich (LMR) cathodes with pure silicon (µ‐Si) anodes offer a promising route toward more sustainable and cost‐effective energy storage. In this study, the capacity fading behavior of LMR||µ‐Si cells is correlated with the poor wettability of the conventional polyolefin Celgard 2500 separator, which leads to non‐uniform electrolyte distribution and localized Li metal deposition on the µ‐Si surface. Consequently, cells with Celgard separators exhibit rapid degradation, with capacity roll‐over occurring after less than 75 cycles. In contrast, replacing Celgard 2500 with an electrospun polyacrylonitrile (PAN) membrane enhances cycling stability, retaining 80% of the initial capacity after approximately 230 cycles, due to improved electrolyte wetting and mechanical contact with µ‐Si anode. Further optimization of the electrolyte composition, using N, N ‐dimethylsulfamoyl fluoride (DMFSA) as co‐solvent with fluoroethylene carbonate (FEC), extends LMR||µ‐Si cell lifetime to more than 400 cycles, regardless of the separator type. These findings highlight the synergistic influence of separator selection and electrolyte formulation in stabilizing interphases at both electrodes. A holistic materials design approach is therefore essential for advancing the performance and durability of next‐generation LMR||µ‐Si‐based LIBs cells.
papers.summary_ko: 코발트가 없는 리튬망간리치(LMR) 양극과 순수 실리콘(µ-Si) 음극을 결합한 전지에서, 기존 Celgard 분리막의 낮은 젖음성이 비균일 전해질 분포와 국소 Li 금속 증착을 유발해 75회 이내에 급격한 용량 저하를 일으킴을 보였다. 전기방사 PAN 분리막으로 교체하면 약 230회까지 80% 용량을 유지했고, DMFSA를 FEC와 함께 공용매로 사용하면 분리막 종류와 무관하게 수명이 400회 이상으로 연장됐다. 분리막과 전해질 조성의 상호작용이 LMR||µ-Si 전지 안정화에 중요함을 제시했다.

papers.title: Physically Grounded Descriptors for Machine-Learning-Guided Diluent Design in Lithium Metal Batteries
papers.venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Localized high-concentration electrolytes require diluents that avoid direct Li+ coordination and preserve Li+-anion aggregates while remaining miscible with the primary solvent. Rational discovery has remained difficult because these competing requirements arise from chemically distinct interactions that have lacked computable molecular design coordinates. Fluorination has therefore been widely used to suppress electron donation, but the environmental persistence and synthetic burden of fluorinated molecules motivate alternative strategies for controlling diluent functionality. Here, we resolve the key interaction requirements of diluents using two complementary descriptors: BF3 affinity for specific electron-pair donation and the molecular polarity index (MPI) for distributed nonspecific electrostatic interactions. These descriptors reproduce established donor-number and Kamlet–Taft π* trends and, more importantly, distinguish noncoordinating yet miscible diluents from solvating and immiscible solvents. Coupling this interaction-based framework with uncertainty-aware machine learning enabled screening of 1.32 million nonfluorinated molecules and identified 368 candidates while recovering false negatives and excluding false positives near the decision boundaries. Newly selected aromatic hydrocarbons, including 1,2,4-trimethylbenzene and 2-ethyltoluene, sustained stable cycling in Li-metal full cells for more than 200 cycles, whereas a descriptor-excluded analogue underwent rapid capacity decay. These results establish specific coordination and distributed electrostatics as predictive design coordinates for diluent discovery.
papers.summary_ko: 리튬 금속 전지용 국부 고농도 전해질에서 Li+와 직접 배위하지 않으면서도 주용매와 혼화성을 유지하는 희석제를 설계하기 위해 BF3 친화도와 분자극성지수(MPI)라는 두 가지 물리 기반 디스크립터를 제안했다. 이를 불소를 포함하지 않는 132만 개 분자에 대한 불확실성 인식 머신러닝 스크리닝에 적용하여 368개의 유망 희석제 후보를 도출했다. 새로 선별된 방향족 탄화수소(1,2,4-트리메틸벤젠, 2-에틸톨루엔 등)는 리튬 금속 완전셀에서 200사이클 이상 안정적으로 구동된 반면, 디스크립터 기준에서 배제된 유사 분자는 급격한 용량 저하를 보였다.
