papers.title: Dual Anion‐Involved Interfacial Chemistry Enables Ultra‐Stable PEO‐Based Solid‐State Lithium Metal Batteries by Suppressing NMP‐Induced Side Reactions
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT The incorporation of solvent N‐methylpyrrolidone (NMP) into polyethylene oxide (PEO) weakens EO‐Li + interaction and boosts Li + transport via strong Li + affinity, but free NMP inevitably reacts with Li metal, undermining interface stability. Herein, we report a dual‐anion coordination strategy that repurposes the residual NMP from a “side‐reaction source” into a “functional component”. LiDFOB and LiNO 3 are introduced as dual‐salt additives into an NMP‐containing PEO/LiTFSI system. Leveraging the preferential coordination of DFOB– and NO 3 – with Li + , an anion‐enriched solvation sheath is constructed, which strengthens the Li + ‐NMP interactions. The modified coordination environment facilitates the preferential formation of a kinetically stable, anion‐derived solid electrolyte interphase (SEI), effectively mitigating interfacial side reactions between the NMP and Li metal. As a result, the obtained electrolyte delivers a high ionic conductivity of 1.69 × 10 −4 S cm −1 and stable cycling over 1200 h at room temperature. The assembled Li/LFP cell exhibits a high capacity retention of 93% after 2000 cycles. Even at room temperate and 0°C, the assembled Li/LFP cell maintains stable and efficient cycling. This work establishes a universal solvent structure tailoring strategy to regulate reactive solvent molecules, opening a fresh avenue for high‐performance PEO‐based solid‐state lithium metal batteries.
papers.summary_ko: PEO 고체 고분자 전해질에 NMP를 첨가하면 Li+ 전달이 향상되지만 잔류 NMP가 리튬 금속과 반응해 계면을 불안정화한다. LiDFOB와 LiNO3를 이중 음이온 첨가제로 도입하여 Li+ 주위에 음이온이 풍부한 솔베이션 쉘을 형성, NMP와의 부반응을 억제하는 동역학적으로 안정한 SEI를 유도했다. 이 전해질은 1.69×10⁻⁴ S/cm의 이온전도도와 상온에서 1200시간 안정 사이클, Li/LFP 셀에서 2000회 후 93% 용량 유지율을 보였다.

papers.title: Bridging Ionic Field Strength Disparity in O3-Type Layered Oxides for High-Voltage Sodium-Ion Batteries
papers.venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society
papers.abstract_en: Abstract O3-type layered oxides represent an attractive class of sodium-ion battery cathodes, combining high theoretical specific capacity and high pristine Na content. However, their deeply desodiated frameworks at high voltages (≥4.0 V) are prone to redox-coupled distortion of TMO6 octahedra within the transition metal (TM) slabs, leading to severe structural degradation. Here, we originally define an ionic field strength disparity coefficient (η), which enables quantitative evaluation of the local chemical-field heterogeneity. The η is derived from the ratio between the standard deviation and the average value of ionic field strength (Φ) of all TM ions, defined as Φ= Z/r2, where Z and r correspond to the ionic charge and ionic radius, respectively. Introducing compensatory cations with an intermediate Φ value between two cations featuring largely disparate Φ values effectively reconciles local chemical-field discrepancy and lowers the η parameter upon charge–discharge processes. Moreover, synchrotron X-ray absorption spectroscopy, strain mapping analyses, and first-principles calculations reveal that the low-η sample demonstrates the reduced lattice strain and enhanced structural reversibility. Consistently, electrochemical evaluation shows that it retains more than 80% of its capacity after 500 cycles at 10C, markedly outperforming the unmodified counterpart with only 22% retention. This work establishes the η as a quantitative descriptor for inactive dopant selection and provides a general strategy for developing highly stable layered oxide cathodes.
papers.summary_ko: O3형 층상 소듐 이온 전지 양극재가 고전압(4.0V 이상)에서 TMO6 팔면체의 산화환원 연계 왜곡으로 구조가 열화되는 문제를 해결하기 위해, 전이금속 이온들의 이온장세기(Φ) 분산 정도를 정량화하는 이온장세기 불균일 계수(η)를 새롭게 정의했다. Φ 값이 중간인 보상 양이온을 도입해 η를 낮추면 충방전 중 국소 화학장 불균일과 격자 변형이 줄어듦을 방사광 X선 흡수분광법, 변형률 매핑, 제일원리 계산으로 확인했다. 그 결과 저η 샘플은 10C, 500사이클 후 80% 이상의 용량 유지율을 보여 미개질 샘플(22%)보다 현저히 우수했다.

papers.title: Anion‐Cation Targeted Regulation Enables Ultrafast and Stable Sodium Metal Batteries at Low Temperatures
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Anion‐dominated solvation and artificial interfacial engineering have been intensively pursued for low‐temperature sodium‐metal batteries (SMBs), yet they face constraints from temperature‐sensitive solvation dynamics and interfacial control. Here we propose anion‐cation‐targeted regulation via Sn(OTf) 2 that simultaneously constructs a solvent‐reinforced solvation structure and electrochemically induces an alloy‐based solid electrolyte interphase (SEI) (Na 15 Sn 4 ), which goes beyond the prevailing anion‐centric strategy to address the critical challenges of SMBs at subzero temperatures. Competitive Sn 2+ ‐Na + coordination excludes PF 6 − from the primary solvation sheath, while OTf − and the ether groups of diethylene glycol dimethyl ether (DEGDME) coupling foster a solvent‐dominated configuration, substantially reducing the Na + desolvation energy barrier at low temperatures. This design enables Na||Na 3 V 2 (PO 4 ) 3 cells to deliver a recorded 1050 cycles at −20°C and 20 C, and nearly 700 cycles at −50°C. Ah‐scale pouch cells sustain durable 450 cycles at −20°C, with a 6 Ah cell reaching 215 Wh kg −1 at 25°C (total cell mass). Our findings resolve the longstanding trade‐off between low‐temperature kinetics and stability in SMBs, offering a new design rationale beyond conventional interfacial engineering.
papers.summary_ko: 저온 소듐 금속 배터리의 전해질 솔베이션과 계면 제어 문제를 해결하기 위해 Sn(OTf)2를 이용한 음이온-양이온 동시 조절 전략을 제안했다. Sn2+와 Na+의 경쟁적 배위로 PF6-를 1차 솔베이션 쉘에서 배제하고 용매 중심의 배위 구조를 형성하여 저온에서 Na+ 탈솔베이션 장벽을 낮추고 합금 기반 SEI(Na15Sn4)를 형성시켰다. Na||Na3V2(PO4)3 전지는 −20°C에서 1050회, −50°C에서 약 700회 사이클을 달성했고, 6Ah 파우치셀은 25°C에서 215 Wh/kg을 보였다.

papers.title: Symmetry-Broken Coordination of Single-Atom Catalysts Unlocks Spin- and Orbital-Regulated Sulfur Redox in Lithium–Sulfur Batteries
papers.venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Sulfur cathodes are considered promising candidates for next-generation energy storage due to their high theoretical energy density, low cost, and elemental abundance. However, their practical deployment is limited by the polysulfide shuttle effect and sluggish sulfur redox reaction (SRR) kinetics. In this study, we design coordination-regulated cobalt single-atom catalysts (CoClNC) featuring an asymmetric Cl–Co–N3 coordination environment to investigate the relationship between SRR catalytic activity and spin state configuration. The incorporation of Cl atoms induces electron delocalization in Co(II), promoting a transition from a low-spin to higher-spin state. This spin-state modulation enhances dz2 orbital hybridization with the π* antibonding orbitals of polysulfides, thereby accelerating their redox conversion. Furthermore, the asymmetric coordination lowers the d-band electron occupancy, improving sulfur species adsorption and facilitating SRR kinetics. Lithium–sulfur batteries employing CoClNC/S cathodes demonstrate remarkable cycling stability, with an average capacity fade of only 0.023% per cycle. This work highlights a general strategy for spin and orbital engineering via coordination field modulation to boost SRR catalysis.
papers.summary_ko: 비대칭 Cl–Co–N3 배위 구조를 갖는 코발트 단일원자 촉매(CoClNC)를 설계하여 리튬-황 배터리의 황 환원반응(SRR) 활성을 조절하였다. Cl 도입으로 Co의 스핀 상태가 저스핀에서 고스핀으로 전환되며 dz2 궤도와 폴리설파이드의 π* 반결합 궤도 간 혼성이 강화되어 환원반응이 가속화된다. 또한 d-band 전자 점유도가 낮아져 황종 흡착이 개선되고 SRR 반응속도가 향상된다. CoClNC/S 캐소드를 적용한 리튬-황 전지는 사이클당 평균 0.023%의 용량 감소율로 우수한 사이클 안정성을 보였다.

papers.title: Spatially resolved host and microbiota RNA profiling in the mouse gut using microDBiT
papers.abstract_en: Hosts and their microbiomes coexist in a shared environment, engaging in dynamic interactions that are essential to maintaining health and modulating disease processes. To fully understand these interactions, spatially resolved and unbiased approaches are needed to map gene expression from both host and microbial cells within their native tissue context. Here, we present microDBiT, a spatial transcriptomic platform that enables simultaneous, high-resolution profiling of host and bacterial RNAs, including both mRNA and rRNA. Using microDBiT, we mapped the spatial distribution of host and microbial transcripts in the ileum and colon of germ-free mice, gnotobiotic mice colonized with a defined gut microbial community, and specific pathogen-free mice treated with dextran sulfate sodium (DSS) to induce colitis. We observed location-specific transcriptomic alterations in both host and bacterial cells in response to colonization and during inflammation. These results demonstrate the utility of microDBiT for dissecting host-microbiome interactions at high resolution and provide new insights into immune responses, spatial microbial localization, and microbiome-associated disease processes. This study introduces microDBiT, a spatial transcriptomics method that maps host and bacterial RNA together in gut tissue, revealing how microbes and host responses vary across intestinal regions and during inflammation.
papers.summary_ko: 호스트와 미생물 군집의 RNA를 동시에 고해상도로 매핑할 수 있는 공간 전사체 플랫폼 microDBiT를 개발하였다. 이를 이용해 무균 마우스, 특정 미생물 군집을 정착시킨 마우스, DSS로 대장염을 유도한 마우스의 회장과 대장에서 호스트 및 세균 전사체의 공간적 분포를 매핑하였다. 그 결과 미생물 정착과 염증 상태에 따라 위치별로 다른 전사체 변화가 나타남을 확인하였다.

papers.title: Nitrobenzo Crown Ether Enables Stable Interphases in Lithium Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Lithium metal anodes promise high‐energy‐density storage but suffer from unstable solid electrolyte interphases and dendrite growth in carbonate electrolytes. Here, 4‐nitrobenzo‐15‐crown‐5 ether (NBCE) is introduced as a multifunctional electrolyte additive that simultaneously regulates Li + solvation and interfacial chemistry. NBCE replaces ethylene carbonate in the Li + solvation sheath, increasing contact ion pairs and substantially lowering the Li + desolvation energy. Its preferential reduction on lithium, accompanied by conversion of the nitro group into Li 3 N, produces a dense LiF‐ and Li 3 N‐rich SEI. Consequently, Li||Cu cells exhibit higher Coulombic efficiency (CE), lower nucleation overpotential, and dense, dendrite‐free lithium deposition, while Li||Li symmetric cells cycle stably for over 1000 h. Li||NCM811 full cells retain 79.5% of their capacity after 300 cycles with an average CE of 99.5%, and deliver approximately 86 mAh g −1 at 5 C. NBCE also significantly suppresses leakage current at high voltages. These findings establish multifunctional solvation and interphase regulation as an effective electrolyte‐design strategy for high‐energy‐density lithium metal batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 4-니트로벤조-15-크라운-5 에테르(NBCE)를 전해질 첨가제로 도입하여 리튬 금속 음극의 솔베이션 구조와 계면 화학을 동시에 조절하였다. NBCE는 Li+ 솔베이션 쉘에서 에틸렌카보네이트를 대체해 접촉 이온쌍을 늘리고 탈솔베이션 에너지를 낮추며, 리튬 표면에서 우선적으로 환원되어 나이트로기가 Li3N으로 전환되면서 LiF 및 Li3N이 풍부한 SEI를 형성한다. 이를 통해 Li||Cu 전지의 쿨롱효율이 향상되고 덴드라이트 없는 리튬 증착이 가능해지며, Li||Li 대칭전지는 1000시간 이상 안정적으로 작동한다. Li||NCM811 완전셀은 300사이클 후 79.5%의 용량 유지율과 99.5%의 평균 쿨롱효율을 보였다.

papers.title: Manipulating Li2MnO3-Like Domain Dispersion in Lithium-Rich Layered Oxides Inherited from Precursor
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Leveraging oxygen redox in lithium-rich layered oxides paves the way for increasing the energy density of lithium-ion batteries, whose practical implementation is plagued by poor stability. Although a uniform Li2MnO3-like domain dispersion is suggested to improve cycle stability, the synthesis–structure relationship governing domain formation remains underexplored. Here, we show that Li2MnO3-like domain dispersion is derived by the precursor structure according to the degree of transition-metal separation. Through a comparative investigation of the synthesis mechanism, we reveal the templating effect that more clustered transition-metal oxide precursors lead to more localized Li2MnO3-like ordering in the final cathodes, a tendency also observed with a different lithium source. Furthermore, it is corroborated that cathodes with more dispersed Li2MnO3-like ordering derived from less-ordered precursors exhibit improved electrochemical stability with a mitigated voltage decay. Our findings highlight the significance of precursor design and engineering for structural regulation of high-performance lithium-rich layered oxide cathodes.
papers.summary_ko: 리튬-리치 층상 산화물 캐소드에서 Li2MnO3 유사 도메인의 분산 정도가 전구체의 전이금속 분리 정도에 의해 결정됨을 규명하였다. 전이금속 산화물 전구체가 더 응집된 구조일수록 최종 캐소드에서 Li2MnO3 유사 질서가 더 국소적으로 형성되는 템플레이팅 효과가 확인되었으며, 이는 리튬 소스를 달리해도 동일하게 나타났다. 전구체 질서가 낮아 Li2MnO3 유사 질서가 더 분산된 캐소드일수록 전기화학적 안정성이 향상되고 전압 감쇄가 완화됨을 입증하였다.

papers.title: Electrolyte-Derived Chemical Activation Enables Reversible Cathode Chemistry in Magnesium Batteries
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Rechargeable magnesium (Mg) metal batteries are promising high-energy-density alternatives to lithium-ion systems, yet sluggish cathode kinetics hinder their development. Departing from the conventional host-centric view, we demonstrate that reversibility in Mg batteries can be governed by electrolyte-derived reaction chemistry. Here, we harness trace water to impart controlled electrolyte reactivity, enabling electrolyte-derived Mg/Cl-containing species to participate in cathode activation. In tunnel-type MnO2, the regulated electrolyte induces lattice expansion and improves electrochemical reversibility. In organic cathodes, improved rechargeability is consistent with a stabilizing role of Cl– in anion-coupled redox. Because polar-solvent chemistry can irreversibly passivate Mg metal, a Sn/MgCl2 artificial interface suppresses parasitic anode reactions while preserving cathode activation. This strategy enables reversible electrochemistry across oxide, organic, and conversion cathodes, including α/γ-MnO2, methylphenothiazine, tetrathiafulvalene, and hybrid I2/O2 systems. These findings establish electrolyte-derived chemical activation as a guiding principle for regulating cathode reaction pathways in magnesium batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 마그네슘 금속전지에서 전해질 유래 화학 활성화를 통해 캐소드 반응의 가역성을 구현하는 전략을 제시하였다. 미량의 수분을 활용해 전해질 반응성을 조절함으로써 Mg/Cl 함유 종이 캐소드 활성화에 참여하도록 하였으며, 터널형 MnO2에서는 격자 팽창을 유도해 가역성을 개선하고 유기 캐소드에서는 Cl-가 음이온 결합 산화환원을 안정화함을 확인하였다. 또한 Sn/MgCl2 인공계면을 통해 분극성 용매로 인한 음극 부반응을 억제하면서 캐소드 활성화를 유지하였다. 이 전략은 산화물, 유기물, 전환형 캐소드 전반에 걸쳐 가역적 전기화학을 구현한다.

papers.title: Alkali hydrides catalyze hydrogenolysis of polystyrene to alkylbenzenes under mild conditions
papers.abstract_en: This study introduces a highly efficient, transition-metal-free method for upcycling polystyrene (PS) waste using alkali metal hydrides, specifically KH, as a catalyst. Operating under mild conditions (130 °C, 1 bar H₂, 3 hours), KH achieves an impressive 93.2% yield of gaseous products and alkylbenzenes, with 95.8% selectivity toward alkylbenzenes. The production rate of 313.3 mmolcarbon/gKH/h is approximately 2.6 times higher than noble-metal catalysts operating at much higher temperatures (280 °C). This versatile approach is effective on diverse real-life PS waste. Mechanistically, depolymerization is driven by a synergy between direct hydride-induced Hδ+(C) abstraction and K+···π interactions with adjacent phenyl rings. This interaction elongates the C(sp³)–C(sp³) bonds, facilitating targeted cleavage into alkylbenzenes. Ultimately, this work establishes hydride catalysis as an energy-efficient platform for plastic depolymerization, providing crucial insights for designing mild-condition catalysts to address the global plastic waste crisis. Catalytic hydrogenolysis has been explored for polystyrene degradation, but its dependence on transition-metal catalysts and harsh conditions reduces its practicality. Here, the authors report the selective hydrogenolysis of polystyrene into alkylbenzenes under mild conditions (low temperature and hydrogen pressure) using alkali metal hydrides.
papers.summary_ko: 폴리스티렌 폐기물을 알칼리 금속 수소화물(KH)을 촉매로 사용해 전이금속 없이 130°C, 1기압 수소 조건에서 알킬벤젠으로 수소분해하는 방법을 제시했다. KH는 기체 및 알킬벤젠 생성물에 대해 93.2% 수율과 95.8%의 알킬벤젠 선택성을 달성했으며, 생산 속도는 더 가혹한 조건에서 작동하는 귀금속 촉매보다 약 2.6배 높았다. 메커니즘적으로는 하이드라이드에 의한 수소 인발과 K+-π 상호작용의 시너지가 C(sp3)-C(sp3) 결합을 늘려 선택적 절단을 유도하는 것으로 나타났다.

papers.title: Ligand Electronics and Metal‐Site Acidity Enable High‐Voltage MOF Electrolytes for Quasi‐Solid‐State Lithium‐Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Lithium‐metal batteries (LMBs) coupled with Ni‐rich cathodes offer high energy density for next‐generation energy storage. Their practical implementation, however, is limited by electrolyte oxidation and interfacial degradation under high voltage. Metal‐organic frameworks (MOFs) would regulate ion solvation and stabilize electrode‐electrolyte interfaces in quasi‐solid‐state electrolytes, yet the molecular origins of their oxidation stability remain unclear. Here, we identify ligand electronics and metal‐site acidity as key descriptors for high‐voltage‐stable MOF electrolytes. Electron‐withdrawing ligands lower the HOMO energy levels of MOFs, while hard Lewis‐acidic Al sites further enhance oxidation resistance. Guided by this principle, we design a perfluorinated Al‐based MOF, Al‐FBDC, featuring a high oxidation onset potential of 4.82 V (vs. Li + /Li). Incorporating Al‐FBDC into a composite cathode reconstructs the local electrolyte environment at particle‐level interfaces, thereby suppressing parasitic reactions and cathode degradation under high‐voltage operation. As a result, Li||Al‐FBDC@NCM quasi‐solid‐state cells deliver excellent long‐term cycling stability and rate performance, retaining 82% of the capacity after 200 cycles at 1 C over 3.0‐4.5 V, while maintaining robust performance even at 4.6 and 4.8 V cut‐off voltages and with controlled electrolyte loading. This work identifies a general design principle for high‐voltage‐stable MOF electrolytes and offers a practical route toward high‐energy‐density LMBs.
papers.summary_ko: 전자를 끄는 리간드와 강한 루이스 산성 Al 자리를 갖는 MOF(Al-FBDC)를 설계해 산화 개시 전위를 4.82V(vs Li+/Li)까지 끌어올린 고전압 안정 준고체 전해질을 개발했다. 이 MOF를 Ni-rich NCM 복합양극에 도입해 입자 수준에서 전해질 환경을 재구성함으로써 고전압 구동 시 부반응과 양극 열화를 억제했다. 그 결과 Li||Al-FBDC@NCM 준고체 전지는 1C, 3.0-4.5V 조건에서 200회 사이클 후 82%의 용량을 유지했고, 4.6V 및 4.8V의 높은 컷오프 전압에서도 안정적인 성능을 보였다.

papers.title: Fluorine-free chlorinated Hückel-type salt for more sustainable and safer all-solid-state lithium metal batteries
papers.abstract_en: All-solid-state lithium metal batteries (ASSLMBs) are promising high-energy-density storage systems, but their practical implementation remains limited by poor electrolyte compatibility with Li metal, safety risks associated with Li° dendrite growth, and the environmental concerns linked to fluorinated battery components, including per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances-related compounds. Since the lithium salt critically governs ion transport, interfacial chemistry, and electrolyte safety, the development of fluorine-free alternatives is essential. Here, we introduce lithium 4,5-dicyano-2-chloroimidazolate (LiDCC), a fluorine-free chlorinated Hückel-type salt, as a conducting solute for solid polymer electrolytes (SPEs) in ASSLMBs. The DCC anion combines a charge-delocalized aromatic framework with chlorine functionality, enabling a rare combination of sustainability, flame retardancy, Li metal compatibility, and aluminum current collector stability. LiDCC-based electrolytes suppress Li° dendrite growth, form a stable solid-electrolyte interphase containing beneficial chlorine-derived species, and remain non-corrosive toward aluminum. Compared with state-of-the-art LiTFSI-based systems, LiDCC-based SPEs deliver improved safety and electrochemical performance, retaining >92% capacity after 100 cycles in Li° || LiFePO 4 cells. These results establish LiDCC as a compelling fluorine-free salt platform for safer, more sustainable, and high-performance ASSLMBs.
papers.summary_ko: 전고체 리튬 금속 배터리(ASSLMB)의 PFAS 등 불소계 성분에 대한 환경 우려를 해결하기 위해 불소가 없는 염화 Hückel형 리튬염 LiDCC(리튬 4,5-디시아노-2-클로로이미다졸레이트)를 고체 고분자 전해질에 도입했다. DCC 음이온은 전하가 비편재화된 방향족 구조와 염소 기능기를 결합하여 난연성과 리튬 금속 적합성, 알루미늄 집전체 내부식성을 동시에 확보한다. LiDCC 기반 전해질은 Li°||LiFePO4 전지에서 100회 사이클 후 92% 이상의 용량을 유지하여 기존 LiTFSI 기반 전해질보다 우수한 성능을 보였다.

papers.title: Durable Interphase Incorporating Cross‐Linked Polymer Enables Long‐Calendar‐Life Lithium Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT The practical deployment of lithium (Li) metal batteries is hindered by not only cycle life but also calendar life. The poor calendar life stems from both the repeated reconstruction of the solid‐electrolyte interphase (SEI) during cycles and, particularly, the continuous growth of SEI during storage. Herein, a durable SEI with high mechanical stability against volume fluctuations and superior passivation capability to suppress electrolyte permeation is demonstrated by integrating inorganics and a cross‐linked polymer into the SEI. Concretely, a cross‐linked polymer with high modulus and low swelling is in‐situ incorporated among the inorganics of an anion‐derived SEI. The elastic modulus of the SEI is significantly increased from 1.63 to 4.37 GPa, and the compactness of the SEI is also improved to suppress electrolyte permeation. Consequently, the cycle life and calendar life of Li metal coin cells are extended by 73% (from 190 to 329 cycles) and 129% (from 1553 to 3561 h), respectively. Furthermore, a prototype pouch cell (506 Wh kg −1 ) undergoes 124 cycles. This work establishes an effective strategy that concurrently improves the mechanical and passivation performance of the SEI, tackling the critical challenge of calendar life in Li metal batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 가교 고분자와 무기 성분을 결합한 내구성 SEI를 리튬 금속 음극에 적용해, 저장 중 지속적인 SEI 성장과 사이클 중 반복적인 재구성 문제를 동시에 해결했다. 이 SEI는 탄성률이 1.63GPa에서 4.37GPa로 증가하고 전해질 투과를 억제하는 치밀한 구조를 가져 기계적 안정성과 패시베이션 성능을 모두 개선했다. 그 결과 리튬 금속 코인셀의 사이클 수명은 73%(190→329회), 저장 수명은 129%(1553→3561시간) 늘었으며, 506Wh/kg급 파우치셀은 124회 사이클을 구동했다.

papers.title: Zr-based oxyhalide superionic electrolyte with self-passivating interphase stabilisation for high-voltage and fast-charging all-solid-state lithium batteries
papers.abstract_en: The pursuit of high-energy-density all-solid-state lithium batteries necessitates integration with next-generation high-voltage positive electrodes. However, a critical challenge lies in the intrinsic instability of most highly ionically conductive solid electrolytes, which decompose at potentials above 4.30 V vs Li+/Li, resulting in severe interfacial degradation and increased impedance. Here, we show that an amorphous Li2Zr0.625Ta0.3Cl4.2O0.9 halide electrolyte, synthesized via a non-equimolar cation-anion amorphous engineering strategy based on Li2ZrCl6, effectively overcomes this limitation. With a high ionic conductivity of 4.11 mS cm−1 at 25 °C, it enables stable high-potential cycling through kinetically stabilized operation mediated by a self-passivating positive electrode–electrolyte interphase. When paired with LiNi0.88Mn0.06Co0.06O2 positive electrode and a Li-In alloy negative electrode, the cells retain up to 81.2% of the initial capacity after 2,000 cycles at 10 C under cell cutoff voltages of 4.18 V (corresponding to 4.80 V vs Li⁺/Li). Overall, non-equimolar cation–anion amorphous engineering enables conductive, high-voltage-tolerant Zr-based halides for all-solid-state lithium batteries. High-voltage solid-state batteries require conductive, stable electrolytes for fast charging. Here, authors show that an amorphous Zr-based oxyhalide electrolyte combines high ionic conductivity with self-passivating interphases, enabling sustained cycling at high voltages.
papers.summary_ko: 비등몰비의 양이온-음이온 비정질화 전략으로 합성한 Li2Zr0.625Ta0.3Cl4.2O0.9 할라이드 고체전해질이 4.11 mS/cm의 높은 이온전도도와 자기부동화(self-passivating) 계면 형성을 통해 4.3V 이상의 고전압에서도 안정적으로 작동함을 보였다. 고니켈 NCM 양극과 Li-In 합금 음극으로 구성한 전고체전지는 10C, 4.18V 컷오프 조건에서 2000회 사이클 후 81.2% 용량을 유지했다.

papers.title: Nonflammable sulfamoyl–carbonate hybrid electrolyte for high-voltage lithium batteries via preemptive passivation
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Achieving high energy density without compromising safety remains a significant challenge for advanced batteries. Nonflammable electrolytes can mitigate fire risk, but poor bulk and interfacial properties of such electrolytes limit their application. Here, a nonflammable sulfamoyl–carbonate electrolyte was developed, achieving a self-extinguishing time of ~0 s and stable cycling in both lithium metal and lithium-ion batteries under high-voltage conditions. The electrolyte comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate dissolved in dimethylsulfamoyl fluoride, fluoroethylene carbonate, and ethyl methyl carbonate at low concentration establishes a weakly solvating environment, wherein dimethylsulfamoyl fluoride and fluoroethylene carbonate preferentially contribute to stabilize the positive and negative electrodes, while working together to enhance the rate capability, low-temperature performance, and long-term cycling at high-voltage. Accelerating rate calorimetry revealed a delayed thermal runaway onset by 87 °C, correlating with Broadness Index. These findings suggest that preemptive passivation on both electrodes, when coupled with nonflammable electrolyte design, can provide a viable route toward safe, high-energy lithium batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 비할로겐계 설포모일-카보네이트 혼합 전해질을 개발하여 자기소화시간 약 0초의 불연성을 구현하고, 고전압 조건에서 리튬 금속 및 리튬이온전지 모두에서 안정적인 사이클링을 달성했다. 디메틸설파모일 플루오라이드와 FEC가 각각 양극과 음극(리튬 금속) 표면에 선제적으로 부동화층을 형성해 율속 특성, 저온 성능, 장기 사이클 안정성을 개선하며 열폭주 개시 온도를 87°C 지연시켰다.

papers.title: Selective Interfacial Coupling in Polymer Electrolytes Stabilizes High‐Voltage Ni‐Rich Cathodes for > 500 Wh Kg −1 Lithium Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT The interfacial chemistry of high‐energy‐density lithium metal batteries (LMBs) is strongly governed by electronic coupling between electrolyte components and cathode surfaces. However, current strategies generally regulate coupling as an overall interaction‐strength issue, overlooking the distinct contributions of individual electrolyte species and thereby limiting precise interfacial control. Here, we propose a selective interfacial coupling strategy by constructing an interfacial architecture comprising a coupling center and a weak‐coupling environment. Specifically, 2‐cyanoethyl acrylate (CA) acts as the coupling center, while a highly fluorinated acrylate (DFA) creates the weak‐coupling environment. Their synergy reconstructs the interfacial molecular organization, suppresses undesirable coupling from non‐target species, and preserves favorable CA‐cathode interactions. Multiscale calculations and operando spectroscopy reveal the reconstructed interfacial structure and its dynamic evolution. The resulting enlarged Ni 3d‐O 2p band‐center separation stabilizes the TM‐O electronic structure, suppressing lattice oxygen release, cation mixing, and transition‐metal dissolution. Consequently, Li||Ni90 cells retain 78% capacity after 400 cycles at 4.7 V, while a 5 Ah pouch cell delivers 529.4 Wh kg −1 at 4.6 V. This work establishes selective interfacial coupling as an effective strategy for regulating high‐voltage interfaces.
papers.summary_ko: 고전압 Ni-rich(Ni90) 양극과 리튬 금속 전지를 위한 고분자 전해질에서 선택적 계면 커플링 전략을 제안했다. 커플링 중심 역할의 CA와 약한 커플링 환경을 만드는 불소화 아크릴레이트(DFA)를 조합해 계면 분자 구조를 재구성하고 Ni 3d-O 2p 밴드센터 분리를 확대하여 격자 산소 방출, 양이온 혼합, 전이금속 용출을 억제했다. 그 결과 Li||Ni90 셀은 4.7V, 400사이클 후 78% 용량 유지율을 보였고, 5Ah 파우치셀은 4.6V에서 529.4 Wh/kg을 달성했다.

papers.title: Hydrocarbothermal Reduction Co‐Upcycling of Spent Lithium‐Ion Batteries via Waste Plastics for Enabling Efficient Water Purification and Lithium Resource Recovery
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT The upcycling of spent lithium‐ion batteries and waste plastics is critical for resource security and sustainable development. However, current recycling paradigms treat these waste streams separately, leading to energy‐intensive battery recovery and low‐value plastic downcycling. Here, we present a waste polyethylene‐driven hydrocarbothermal reduction strategy for upcycling spent LiNi 0.6 Co 0.2 Mn 0.2 O 2 (NCM 622 ) cathodes by exploiting the dual functions of plastics as in situ carbon sources and reducing agents, making a breakthrough on their co‐processing and joint upcycling, and constructing a closed‐loop system integrating mixed‐waste upcycling, water purification, and lithium recycling. Hydrocarbothermal reduction via polyethylene pyrolysis induces pronounced interlayer expansion and octahedral distortion within NCM 622 , triggering structural collapse and driving the formation of a stable NiCoMn alloy nanorod deposited on a carbon nanosheet (NiCoMn/C) catalyst. Kinetic analysis shows that Co sites act as the primary catalytic centers, while Ni and Mn mediate charge transfer. NiCoMn/C enables efficient peroxymonosulfate (PMS) activation for bisphenol A degradation with a rate constant of 0.411 min −1 , demonstrating competitive catalytic performance among reported alloy–carbon catalysts. Meanwhile, this system achieves 87% lithium recovery, reduced greenhouse gas emissions, and strong economic viability. This work establishes a generalizable paradigm for integrated waste‐to‐resource conversion and environmental remediation.
papers.summary_ko: 폐리튬이온전지의 NCM622 양극과 폐플라스틱(폴리에틸렌)을 공동 업사이클링하는 하이드로카르보써멀 환원 전략을 제시했다. 폴리에틸렌 열분해를 탄소원 및 환원제로 활용해 NCM622를 NiCoMn 합금 나노로드/탄소 나노시트(NiCoMn/C) 촉매로 전환했으며, 이 촉매는 과황산수소나트륨(PMS) 활성화를 통한 비스페놀 A 분해에 효과적이었다. 동시에 87%의 리튬 회수율과 온실가스 감소, 경제성을 확보했다.

papers.title: Grain Boundary Character Governs Lithium Deposition Uniformity on Polycrystalline Copper
papers.abstract_en: Abstract In anode-free Li metal batteries, a bare current collector must be converted into a reversible Li metal anode during the first charge, making Li nucleation decisive for reversibility. However, how current collector microstructure governs Li nucleation and growth remains poorly understood, since prior studies focused on single-crystal surfaces to identify favorable crystallographic orientations, leaving grain boundaries unexplored. Here, we identify grain boundary density and character in copper current collectors as key regulators of Li deposition uniformity. Systematic annealing decouples grain size from surface chemistry, revealing that deposition uniformity improves with copper grain coarsening but saturates as disordered boundaries are eliminated during grain growth, leaving predominantly low-energy configurations. Atomistic simulations show disordered boundaries impose high barriers to Li adatom migration, whereas ordered boundaries and adjacent low-index terraces provide low-barrier pathways for redistribution. Copper foils engineered beyond this threshold sustain uniform Li plating across diverse electrolytes and improve cyclability in anode-free cells.
papers.summary_ko: 무음극(anode-free) 리튬 금속 전지에서 구리 집전체의 결정립계 특성이 리튬 증착 균일성을 좌우함을 규명했다. 결정립 조대화에 따라 증착 균일성이 향상되지만 무질서한 결정립계가 사라지면 포화되며, 원자 시뮬레이션은 무질서한 결정립계가 리튬 원자 이동을 저해하는 반면 정렬된 결정립계와 인접한 저지수 테라스는 낮은 장벽의 확산 경로를 제공함을 보였다. 이 임계점을 넘어 설계된 구리 포일은 다양한 전해질에서 균일한 리튬 도금과 무음극 셀의 향상된 사이클 특성을 나타냈다.

papers.title: Site‐Preferential Trace Phosphorus Substitution Accelerates and Stabilizes the Activation of Lithium‐Rich Cathode Materials
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Lithium‐rich manganese‐based layered oxides can access both transition‐metal and oxygen redox, but activation of the monoclinic Li 2 MnO 3 component is usually sluggish and structurally unstable. Uncontrolled activation promotes irreversible lattice distortion, oxygen‐related degradation, voltage decay, and capacity loss. Here we use trace phosphorus substitution to regulate the activation pathway of a Li‐rich Mn‐based cathode. Structural, spectroscopic, microscopic, and theoretical analyses show that P tends to incorporate at Li‐layer sites near Ni‐containing local environments. This site‐selective substitution modifies the Li‐slab structure and adjacent Ni─O/O electronic environment, enabling more effective activation of the Li‐rich monoclinic component with a self‐relaxing lattice response. As a result, the P‐substituted cathode reaches a peak discharge capacity of 273.1 mAh g −1 at the 50th cycle and still delivers 270.5 mAh g −1 after 300 cycles.
papers.summary_ko: 리튬 과잉 망간계 층상 산화물 양극에서 Li2MnO3 성분의 활성화가 느리고 구조적으로 불안정한 문제를 해결하기 위해 미량의 인(P)을 site-selective하게 도입했다. P는 Ni 인접 Li층 자리에 우선적으로 치환되어 Li-슬랩 구조와 Ni-O/O 전자 환경을 조절함으로써 모노클리닉 상의 활성화를 안정적으로 유도한다. 이를 통해 P 치환 양극은 50사이클에서 273.1 mAh g-1의 최대 방전용량을 나타내고 300사이클 후에도 270.5 mAh g-1을 유지한다.

papers.title: Near‐Micron Single‐Crystalline Mn‐Rich Cathodes With Exceptional Cycling Stability
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Achieving high‐energy‐density and long‐term cycling stability in Mn‐redox‐based cathodes is a critical step toward advancing Ni‐ and Co‐free Li‐ion chemistries to diversify supply chains and lower battery costs. Here, we demonstrate an unusually high performance benchmark for Mn‐redox cathodes using near‐micron single‐crystalline δ‐phase cation‐disordered rocksalt (δ‐DRX), derived from Mn‐rich DRX, delivering ≈640 Wh kg −1 with ≈97% capacity retention over 400 cycles. The very high energy density and cycle life were achieved by using a high Mn content, to suppress oxygen redox activity, and careful control of the synthesis parameters to tune single crystal particle size. Using high‐throughput automated electron microscopy, we identify interparticle compositional heterogeneity present in the early stage of phase‐pure DRX formation as the origin of orthorhombic LiMnO 2 impurity formation during cooling, a finding that rationalizes the long high‐temperature dwell times required and the associated particle coarsening in conventional synthesis. We demonstrate that an accelerated cooling strategy kinetically suppresses localized impurity formation, reducing long high‐temperature exposure, and enables downsizing of single‐crystalline Mn‐rich DRX particles to the near‐micron regime (D50 = 1.5 µm). This work provides a mechanistic basis for particle‐size control in Mn‐rich DRX synthesis, and presents δ‐DRX as a stable, sustainable, high‐performance, Ni‐ and Co‐free cathode material.
papers.summary_ko: Ni·Co-free Mn-redox 기반 양극재의 에너지 밀도와 장기 안정성을 동시에 확보하기 위해 마이크론 이하 크기의 단결정 δ상 양이온 무질서 암염형(DRX) 구조를 구현했다. 높은 Mn 함량으로 산소 redox를 억제하고 급속 냉각 전략으로 냉각 중 발생하는 사방정계 LiMnO2 불순물 형성을 억제하여 입자를 D50=1.5 µm 수준까지 축소했다. 그 결과 약 640 Wh kg-1의 에너지 밀도와 400사이클 후 약 97%의 용량 유지율을 달성했다.

papers.title: Dendritic computation for abstract rule-based flexible decision-making
papers.abstract_en: Intelligent behavior involves flexible integration of sensory input and abstract rule knowledge. Dendritic computation has been shown to contribute to top-down modulation of sensory processing; however, whether and how it is involved in flexible cognitive processing remains to be elucidated. Combining a rule-based flexible decision-making task with in vivo two-photon imaging and optogenetics in mice, we found that within single layer 5 extratelencephalic neurons in the auditory cortex, apical dendrites preferentially encoded the inferred abstract rule and somata preferentially represented sensory stimuli, whereas choice signals were present in both compartments. Optogenetic dendritic inhibition impaired rule-dependent somatic choice coding, supporting a task-relevant integration across the dendritic and somatic compartments. These results indicate that dendritic computation in cortical neurons mediates flexible behavior.
papers.summary_ko: 대뇌 청각 피질 5층 피라미드 신경세포에서 정점 가지돌기(apical dendrite)와 체세포(soma)가 서로 다른 정보를 담당함을 두 광자 이미징과 광유전학으로 규명한 연구이다. 가지돌기는 추론된 추상적 규칙을, 체세포는 감각 자극을 우선적으로 인코딩하며, 선택 신호는 두 구획 모두에 존재한다. 가지돌기 억제는 규칙 기반 선택 코딩을 손상시켜 가지돌기 연산이 유연한 행동에 기여함을 시사한다.

papers.title: Closed-loop upcycling of residual lithium in LiFePO4 into tunable thin lithium metal electrodes
papers.abstract_en: Abstract With the rapid development of electric vehicles, massive quantities of spent lithium iron phosphate batteries are generated, creating an urgent demand for efficient and sustainable recycling. Here we show a redox mediator-assisted strategy that directly converts simulated spent lithium iron phosphate powder into thin lithium metal, reducing energy requirements and enabling regeneration of the redox mediator. The process achieves a 98% final lithium extraction and produces lithium foils with a preformed interphase, tolerating volume changes and resisting air corrosion. The recycled Li (4.14 mAh cm −2 ) enables Li | |Li cells to cycle over 1,200 h at the test condition of 1 mA cm −2 / 1 mAh cm −2 and shows stable interfacial resistance with reduced electrolyte decomposition. When paired with NCM811, the cells retain 91.4% capacity over 400 cycles at 0.2 C/0.3 C. This closed-loop process couples lithium recovery with designed electrode fabrication, providing an alternative pathway for sustainable battery recycling and negative electrode design.
papers.summary_ko: 폐 LiFePO4 분말에서 잔류 리튬을 환원 매개체(redox mediator) 보조 전략으로 직접 추출하여 얇은 리튬 금속 전극으로 전환하는 폐쇄루프 업사이클링 공정을 제시했다. 이 공정은 98%의 리튬 회수율을 달성하고, 기 형성된 계면(interphase)을 가진 리튬 호일을 생성해 부피 변화에 견디고 공기 부식에 저항한다. 회수된 리튬 전극은 Li||Li 셀에서 1200시간 이상 안정적으로 순환하며, NCM811과 조합 시 400사이클 후 91.4%의 용량을 유지한다.

papers.title: γ‐Ray Controlled Topological Evolution of Binders for Stable and Activated Li─S Battery Cathodes
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT γ‐ray irradiation facilitates controllable, clean, and reagent‐free cross‐linking of polymer networks without side reactions. Leveraging these merits, we precisely tune the irradiation dose to engineer a three‐dimensional (3D) poly(vinyl alcohol) (PVA) binder network for lithium‐sulfur (Li─S) batteries. By integrating multiscale synchrotron radiation X‐ray characterization techniques, we elucidate how the γ‐ray irradiation dose governs the 3D network structure and consequently regulates sulfur cathode stability and sulfur reaction kinetics without using catalysts. The optimal dose of 3 kGy yields a favorable PVA binder network featuring a dense framework, favorable connectivity, and homogeneous spatial distribution. The interpenetrating structure composed of binder, sulfur, and conductive agent leads to coupling of the mechanical architecture with the electron‐conductive network, accompanied by high‐flux lithium‐ion diffusion, thereby relieving cathode volume variation and promoting sulfur interconversion kinetics. This resulting sulfur cathode delivers a capacity decay rate of only 0.045% per cycle over 1000 cycles at 1 C. Moreover, a 1.23 Ah‐level pouch cell fabricated with the 3 kGy dose‐enabled PVA (3‐PVA) binder achieves an energy density of 390.2 Wh kg −1 . This study highlights γ‐ray irradiation as a clean and controllable strategy to engineer binder topological structure, disclosing dose‐dependent structure–property relationships that govern electrode mechanics and electrochemistry.
papers.summary_ko: 감마선 조사량을 정밀하게 조절하여 리튬-황(Li-S) 전지용 PVA 바인더의 3차원 가교 네트워크 구조를 제어했다. 최적 조사량(3 kGy)에서 형성된 조밀하고 균일한 바인더 네트워크는 전자 전도 경로와 기계적 구조를 결합시켜 황 양극의 부피 변화를 완화하고 전환 반응 속도를 향상시켰다. 이 바인더를 적용한 황 양극은 1C에서 1000회 사이클 동안 사이클당 0.045%의 낮은 용량 감쇠율을 보였으며, 1.23 Ah급 파우치셀에서 390.2 Wh/kg의 에너지 밀도를 달성했다.

papers.title: Unraveling the Origins of C‐Rate Dependent Capacity Decay in Fe‐Mn‐Based Prussian Blue Cathodes for Sodium Ion Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Prussian blue analogues (PBAs), especially low‐cost Mn‐doped Fe‐based PBAs, demonstrate significant potential for power‐type sodium‐ion batteries (SIBs), owing to their open framework and high theoretical capacity (∼170 mAh g −1 ). However, their capacity decay mechanisms, particularly under rapid charge/discharge conditions, remain insufficiently understood, hindering their practical implementation in high‐power energy storage systems. Here, we systematically investigate the failure mechanisms of Mn‐doped Fe‐based PBAs through multiple in/ex situ characterizations of Mn‐doped Fe‐PBA cathodes cycled under various current densities. Our analysis reveals that there are several pathways induce electrode degradation at high rate: (1) transition metal dissolution that disrupts redox‐active sites, (2) mechanical degradation that impairs electrode kinetics under high‐rate conditions, (3) severe and rapid Na dendrite growth, and (4) interfacial side reactions that generate a thick cathode‐electrolyte interphase layer. Rather than viewing transition metal dissolution and mechanical degradation as isolated degradation pathways, this study reveals that capacity collapse at 10 C is fundamentally driven by the intrinsic kinetic mismatch and mechanical failure, offering key insights for the design of durable, high‐power PBA‐based SIBs.

papers.title: Surface carbonation governs olivine reactivity for rapid CO2 mineralization
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Ultramafic rocks are a global resource with vast potential for permanent CO 2 mineralization. However, the origin of the striking reactivity difference between Ca- and Mg-bearing olivine remains poorly understood. Here we show that this difference arises not merely from the type of cation, but more fundamentally from how these cations modulate the oxygen reactivity. Nonbridging oxygens serve as the oxygen source for CO 2 surface reactions, which in Ca-olivine reduce the Ca 2+ dissolution barrier by 60% and accelerate ion release by six orders of magnitude. The calculated apparent dissolution rate constants reproduce the experimentally observed complete conversion of Ca-olivine within hours under 1 atm CO 2 . This multiscale framework reveals how surface reactions govern silicate carbonation and provides a predictive basis for modeling and engineering large-scale CO 2 mineralization in both synthetic materials and basaltic reservoirs.
papers.summary_ko: Ca- 및 Mg-함유 감람석(olivine)의 CO2 반응성 차이가 양이온 자체보다 비가교 산소의 반응성 조절에서 기인함을 보인 연구이다. Ca-감람석에서는 Ca2+ 용해 장벽이 60% 감소하고 이온 방출 속도가 6자리수 가속되어 1기압 CO2 조건에서 수 시간 내 완전 전환이 가능함을 실험적으로 확인했다. 이 결과는 표면 반응이 규산염 탄산화를 지배하는 기전을 설명하는 다중스케일 프레임워크를 제시한다.

papers.title: Spatially Integrated Intercalation–Conversion Hybrid Cathode for Durable, High‐Capacity Lithium Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT The fundamental trade‐off between structural stability and high capacity remains a key challenge in Li‐ion battery cathode design, especially in cost‐sensitive, large‐scale applications. Here, we present a spatially integrated intercalation–conversion hybrid cathode that combines LiFePO 4 and sulfur‐based materials within a monolayer architecture. This earth‐abundant composition synchronizes Li‐ion intercalation with the solid‐liquid sulfur conversion reaction: LiFePO 4 serves as a mechanically robust Li host and a chemical regulator that suppresses polysulfide shuttles, while sulfur‐based materials provide high specific capacity. By rationally tailoring the cathode composition and electrolyte solvation chemistry, we reveal how electrolyte–cathode synergistic interactions govern active material utilization, interfacial kinetics, and long‐term stability. The optimized Li‐metal battery delivers stable cycling over 3000 cycles with a low‐capacity decay rate of 0.016% per cycle at 5 C and also demonstrates stable cycling under practical asymmetric cycling protocols. This work provides a new design principle for hybrid cathodes, offering a scalable pathway toward ultra‐durable and high‐capacity Li‐metal batteries.
papers.summary_ko: LiFePO4와 황 기반 물질을 단일층 구조 내에 공간적으로 통합한 인터칼레이션-전환 하이브리드 양극을 제안했다. LiFePO4는 기계적으로 안정적인 리튬 호스트 및 폴리설파이드 셔틀 억제 역할을 하고, 황 기반 물질은 높은 비용량을 제공하여 두 반응을 동기화시켰다. 전해질-양극 조성 최적화를 통해 이 리튬 금속전지는 5C에서 사이클당 0.016%의 낮은 용량 감쇠율로 3000회 이상의 안정적인 사이클링을 달성했다.

papers.title: Solvation‐Equilibrium Locking Enables Ultrawide‐Temperature Operation of High‐Voltage Lithium‐Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT High‐energy lithium metal batteries are promising for space, polar, deep‐sea, and other extreme environments, but their operation is constrained by temperature‐sensitive ion transport, Li + solvation, and interfacial chemistry. A solvation‐equilibrium‐locked electrolyte (SELE) is reported by combining dimethyl sulfite (DMS), a low‐freezing weakly solvating solvent, with Pyr 13 DFOB (1‐methyl‐1‐propylpyrrolidinium difluoro(oxalato)borate) as an ionic‐liquid co‐solvent. Cooperative ion–dipole and weak C–H⋯O interactions between DMS and Pyr 13 + regulate the free‐solvent reservoir, while TFSI − (bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide) and DFOB − enrich the primary Li + coordination shell. Variable‐temperature 7 Li NMR, Raman, and molecular dynamics simulations show that solvent‐separated ion pairs, contact ion pairs, and aggregates remain nearly invariant from −60°C to 60°C, unlike the strongly temperature‐responsive Pyr 13 DFOB‐free electrolyte. This locked anion‐rich solvation structure reduces solvent coordination around Li + , mitigates solvent‐derived interfacial decomposition and gas evolution, and promotes LiF‐ and borate‐rich interphases on Li metal and NMC811. Consequently, Li||NMC811 cells deliver discharge capacity at −85°C and operate up to 120°C, while pouch cells remain functional after cooling to −122.9°C. A 6.6 Ah Li||Ni90 pouch cell further achieves 565 Wh kg −1 under lean‐electrolyte conditions, establishing solvation‐equilibrium locking as a molecular design principle for lithium metal batteries operating over a broad temperature range.
papers.summary_ko: 저융점 약한 솔베이팅 용매(DMS)와 이온성 액체 Pyr13DFOB를 결합한 솔베이션-평형-고정 전해질(SELE)을 통해 -60°C~60°C 범위에서 Li+ 솔베이션 구조를 거의 일정하게 유지시켰다. 이 전해질은 Li+ 주변 용매 배위를 줄여 용매 유래 계면 분해와 가스 발생을 억제하고, Li 금속과 NMC811 표면에 LiF 및 보레이트가 풍부한 계면을 형성한다. 그 결과 Li||NMC811 셀은 -85°C에서도 방전이 가능하고 120°C까지 작동하며, 6.6 Ah Li||Ni90 파우치셀은 저전해질 조건에서 565 Wh kg-1을 달성했다.

papers.title: Rotation‐Coupled Guest Anions Stabilize Polymer Solid‐State Sodium‐Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Polymer solid‐state sodium‐metal batteries are constrained by sluggish Na + migration and unstable sodium–metal interfaces, both of which are closely associated with poorly regulated solvation chemistry. Here we report a rotation‐coupled guest‐anion strategy in a poly(vinylidene fluoride‐co‐hexafluoropropylene)‐based solid‐state electrolyte (PHSE) using Mg(OTf) 2 . Mg 2+ preferentially coordinates DMF and TFSI − , weakening Na + –TFSI − association and limiting solvent‐derived reactions at the sodium metal anode. OTf − enters the Na + solvation shell as a mobile guest anion. Its C─S rotational axis and equivalent oxygen coordination sites allow conformational rotation to synchronize with Na + hopping along polymer chains. This anchor–rotator chemistry reorganizes Na + coordination, lowers the migration barrier, and promotes an inorganic‐rich, Mg─O‐containing interphase. The optimized electrolyte enables Na 3 V 2 (PO 4 ) 3 ||Na cells to retain 94.2% capacity after 1100 cycles at 2C and supports a 94 mAh pouch cell with stable cycling. It also enables high‐voltage Na 3 V 2 (PO 4 ) 2 O 2 F||Na cells to retain 93.6% capacity after 1000 cycles at 0.5C over 2.5–4.2 V. Comparative evaluation across a total of 20 polymer electrolyte systems with varied polymer matrices and anion structures identifies anion symmetry, rotational periodicity, and finite rotational barriers as molecular criteria for designing stable polymer solid‐state sodium‐metal batteries.

Mg2+은 DMF와 TFSI-를 우선 배위해 Na+-TFSI- 결합을 약화시키고, OTf-는 C-S 회전축을 이용해 Na+ 이동에 동조하며 이동장벽을 낮추고 무기물이 풍부한 계면을 형성한다. 이 전해질은 Na3V2(PO4)3||Na 셀에서 2C로 1100사이클 후 94.2% 용량을 유지하고, Na3V2(PO4)2O2F||Na 고전압 셀에서도 1000사이클 후 93.6% 용량을 유지한다.

papers.title: Rapid Renin Angiotensin Aldosterone System inhibitor optimisation in patients with chronic kidney disease and heart failure with reduced ejection fraction using potassium binder: a randomised, double-blinded, placebo-controlled trial
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Renin-angiotensin-aldosterone inhibitors (RAASi) improve outcomes in patients with heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF), but their use is often limited by hyperkalaemia in chronic kidney disease (CKD) patients. This double-blind, placebo-controlled, randomised trial evaluated whether sodium zirconium cyclosilicate (SZC) enables RAASi up-titration in HFrEF patients with CKD stages 3–5 and serum potassium of 5.0–5.5 mmol/L over 14 weeks. The primary binary outcome was defined as achieving the target dose of RAAS inhibition therapy without reaching hyperkalaemia (serum potassium ≥5.6 mmol/L) over 14 weeks or otherwise. Participants ( n = 112) were randomised 1:1 to receive sodium zirconium cyclosilicate (SZC) or placebo. The per-protocol (PP) analyses included 43 out of 53 (81%) in the SZC arm and 53 out of 59 participants (90%) in the placebo arm; the intention-to-treat (ITT) analyses included all 112. At the end of the trial, 24 of 43 participants (56%) in the SZC group achieved the target RAASi dose without developing hyperkalaemia compared with 15 of 53 patients (28%) in the placebo group (PP analysis, p = 0.006, ITT analysis, p = 0.007,). Participants in the SZC group were 3 times more likely to reach the target dose without reaching potassium 5.6 mmol/L (OR = 3.16; 95% CI 1.35–7.39; p = 0.008) than in the placebo group (ITT analysis). No significant differences in adverse events between the two groups were observed. SZC appears to safely support rapid RAASi optimisation in HFrEF patients with CKD. This trial was funded by AstraZeneca via Externally Sponsored Scientific Research grant ESR-19-20174. Trial Registration: Clinicaltrials.gov NCT05004363 and EudraCT number 2020-002946-18.
papers.summary_ko: 만성 신장질환과 박출률 감소 심부전 환자에서 포타슘 결합제(SZC)를 병용하여 RAAS 억제제 용량을 증량할 수 있는지 평가한 무작위 이중맹검 대조시험이다. SZC군은 위약군보다 과칼륨혈증 없이 목표 용량에 도달한 비율이 유의하게 높았다(PP 56% 대 28%, p=0.006). 두 군 간 이상반응 발생률에는 유의한 차이가 없었다.

papers.title: Engineered TYK2 dependence enables myeloid-selective IL-10 receptor agonism
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Interleukin-10 (IL-10) is a central anti-inflammatory cytokine that suppresses immune responses in myeloid cells but can also activate T cells, limiting its therapeutic use in chronic inflammatory diseases owing to narrow efficacy windows and dose-limiting toxicities 1–5 . Here we show that myeloid and T cells differ in their dependence on JAK-family kinase pairing for IL-10 signalling and function. We took advantage of this differential kinase dependence to engineer a tetravalent nanobody-based myeloid-selective IL-10 receptor agonist (msIL-10R agonist) that fully recapitulates IL-10’s potent suppression of monocytes, macrophages and dendritic cells while avoiding stimulation of T cells. Cryo-electron microscopy structural analysis reveals a distinct receptor cross-linking geometry of the msIL-10R agonist compared with native IL-10 family cytokines. This tetravalent architecture renders signalling strictly TYK2-dependent and highly sensitive to IL-10Rα and IL-10Rβ receptor abundance, thereby conferring selective activity in myeloid cells. This msIL-10R agonist reduces inflammation in humanized mouse models of lipopolysaccharide challenge, delayed-type hypersensitivity and colitis. A humanized version exhibits IgG-like pharmacokinetics, sustained receptor occupancy and durable myeloid suppression up to 30 days without T cell activation or haematological toxicities in non-human primates. These findings establish a geometry-based strategy for achieving cell-type-selective cytokine signalling and identify the msIL-10R agonist as a therapeutic candidate for myeloid-driven inflammatory diseases, including inflammatory bowel diseases.
papers.summary_ko: IL-10 신호에서 골수계 세포와 T세포가 JAK 계열 키나제 짝짓기에 대한 의존성이 다르다는 점을 활용해, TYK2 의존적인 골수세포 선택적 IL-10 수용체 작용제(msIL-10R agonist)를 4가(tetravalent) 나노바디 기반으로 개발했다. 냉동전자현미경 구조 분석으로 기존 IL-10과 다른 수용체 가교 형태를 확인했으며, 이 작용제는 T세포 활성화 없이 단핵구·대식세포·수지상세포의 염증을 억제한다. 인간화 마우스 염증 모델과 비인간 영장류에서 최대 30일간 T세포 비활성 상태로 지속적인 골수세포 억제 효과를 보였다.

papers.title: Beyond Facet Engineering: Dislocation‐Mediated Nucleation Enables Stable Lithium Deposition on Practical Polycrystalline Cu Collectors
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Uniform Li deposition on practical Cu current collectors remains challenging in lithium metal batteries. Despite extensive efforts in facet engineering, achieving homogeneous Li deposition on practical polycrystalline Cu collectors remains elusive, highlighting an incomplete understanding of the structural factors governing Li deposition. Herein, a defect‐mediated interfacial engineering strategy is developed by simultaneously introducing a high density of geometrically necessary dislocations (GNDs) and enriched / textures on commercial electrodeposited Cu foils. Theoretical calculations and experiments reveal that densely distributed dislocations provide thermodynamically favorable Li adsorption sites and abundant preferential heterogeneous nucleation sites, while the enriched / textures promote Li surface diffusion and lateral growth. This combined effect promotes uniform and compact initial Li deposition, guiding path‐dependent deposition evolution and suppressing interfacial heterogeneity. The control experiments further support a key contribution of dislocation defects, while variations in surface chemistry or morphology alone cannot account for the observed performance differences. The optimized Cu foil sustains over 1200 cycles with an average Coulombic efficiency of 99.52% ± 0.20% over the final 200 cycles ( n = 4) in Li||Cu cells and improves N/P = 0 Cu||NCM811 full‐cell cycling. This work establishes dislocation‐mediated nucleation and orientation‐regulated growth as a design principle for practical Cu current collectors.
papers.summary_ko: 상용 다결정 Cu 집전체 표면에 전위(dislocation)를 도입하여 리튬 금속전지에서 균일한 Li 증착을 유도하는 전략을 제시했다. 조밀하게 분포된 전위가 열역학적으로 유리한 Li 흡착 및 불균일 핵생성 자리를 제공하고, 특정 결정면 조직이 Li의 표면 확산과 측방 성장을 촉진하여 균일하고 조밀한 초기 Li 증착을 유도함을 이론 계산과 실험으로 입증했다. 최적화된 Cu 집전체는 Li||Cu 셀에서 1200회 이상의 사이클과 평균 99.52%의 쿨롱 효율을 보였다.

papers.title: Anion Co‐Intercalation in Conductive 2D MOFs via π‐d Hybridization for High‐Performance Magnesium Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Rechargeable magnesium batteries (RMBs) are a promising post‐lithium battery technology due to abundant magnesium reserves, high volumetric capacity, and dendrite‐free Mg anodes. However, the strong electrostatic interaction between Mg 2+ and inorganic cathode lattices causes high diffusion barriers and sluggish kinetics. To circumvent this, two‐dimensional conductive metal‐organic frameworks (2D c‐MOFs), featuring favorable electronic transport characteristics arising from π‐d hybridization and structural tunability, have attracted widespread attention. This work systematically investigates the electrochemical performance of M 3 (HITP) 2 (M = Co, Ni, Cu; HITP = 2,3,6,7,10,11‐hexaiminotriphenylene) as cathodes for RMBs and reveals the decisive role of the metal center in Mg storage. All three materials achieve synergistic dual‐ion storage through heteroatomic N coordination with Mg 2+ coupled with anion intercalation. Among them, Ni 3 (HITP) 2 demonstrates superior overall performance, arising from its characteristic Ni 2+ d 8 electronic configuration, which facilitates the formation of a stable Ni‐N coordination environment and effective π‐d conjugation. It retains approximately 201 mAh g −1 after 1100 cycles at 1.0 A g −1 , corresponding to a high‐capacity retention of 98.0%. This study elucidates how different metal centers regulate Mg storage in 2D c‐MOFs, providing molecular‐level guidance for designing high‐performance organic cathodes for multivalent‐ion batteries.
papers.summary_ko: π-d 혼성화 기반의 2차원 전도성 금속-유기 골격체(MOF)를 마그네슘 전지 양극으로 적용해 금속 중심(Co, Ni, Cu)이 Mg 저장 성능에 미치는 영향을 규명했다. Ni3(HITP)2는 안정적인 Ni-N 배위 환경과 효과적인 π-d 결합으로 세 소재 중 가장 우수한 성능을 보였으며, 1.0 A/g에서 1100회 사이클 후에도 약 201 mAh/g의 용량(98.0% 용량 유지율)을 유지했다.

papers.title: Wireless, optoelectronic, multimodal skin sensor for simultaneous monitoring of mechanical stress and vascular responses
papers.abstract_en: Prolonged mechanical loading and subsequent vascular ischemia drive the development of severe pressure injuries. Effective prevention of irreversible tissue damage requires monitoring both multiaxial mechanical forces and physiological erythema. However, conventional diagnostic tools remain limited by rigid architectures, single parameter detection, and subjective visual assessments. Here, a wireless, battery free optoelectronic multimodal sensor platform provides an integrated framework for tracking posture dependent mechanical loading and localized erythema. The soft, skin conformable device uses geometric light modulation within an isolated optical cavity to quantify normal pressure and biaxial shear stresses. To resolve complex mechanical environments, a deep neural network regression model decouples simultaneous tri-axial forces, Fx, Fy, and Fz, at the skin interface. Concurrently, a dual wavelength optical reflectance mechanism quantifies skin erythema by capturing subtle variations in hemoglobin absorption. Opaque elastomeric encapsulation shields the internal optics, supporting stable optical measurements under varying ambient illumination and skin conditions. System level integration via near field communication enables untethered operation across a multiplexed sensor network. On-body evaluations in a simulated clinical bed setting demonstrate the ability of the platform to dynamically map posture-dependent biomechanical loading and localized vascular responses, providing a technological basis for future studies on data-driven monitoring of the mechanical and vascular factors associated with pressure-injury risk. Pressure injuries arise from sustained mechanical loading and reduced blood flow, but current tools cannot objectively track both together. Cho et al. built a soft, wireless, battery-free, optoelectronic sensor that simultaneously maps three-axis stress and redness on the body.
papers.summary_ko: 압력 손상 위험을 모니터링하기 위해 기계적 응력과 혈관 반응(홍반)을 동시에 측정하는 무선, 배터리-프리 광전자 피부 센서를 개발한 연구이다. 광학 공동 기반의 변형 감지와 이중 파장 반사율 측정을 결합하여 3축 힘과 피부 홍반을 비접촉으로 정량화했다. 배터리 소재와는 무관한 생체의료 센서 연구이다.

papers.title: Targeting MDA5 induces immunogenic cell death and promotes anti-tumor immunity
papers.abstract_en: Identifying targets to enhance tumor immunity is an urgent need. Although nucleic acid sensors play critical roles in promoting tumor immune clearance, their exceptionally low mutation rate in cancers suggests potential unexplored roles in tumor progression. Here, we demonstrate that the RNA sensor melanoma differentiation-associated protein 5 (MDA5) promotes immune evasion, and its high expression is strongly predictive of poor survival and resistance to immune checkpoint blockade (ICB) therapy in patients. Targeting MDA5 reshapes the tumor microenvironment, strengthening immune memory responses and enhancing effector CD8⁺ T cell activity in preclinical models in female mice. Mechanistically, MDA5 deficiency triggers unfolded protein response driven immunogenic cell death through induction of damage-associated molecular patterns, leading to enhanced dendritic cell-mediated antigen engulfment and T cell activation. Additionally, MDA5 loss primes the ASK1-JNK/P38 signaling pathway, sensitizing tumor cells to TNF-α/IFN-γ, further amplifying this process. Consequently, targeting MDA5 enhances the efficacy of ICB therapy across multiple cancer types, positioning it as a promising therapeutic target. RNA sensors have been linked to antitumor immune responses. Here, based on results of in vivo CRISPR screens, the authors propose the RNA sensor MDA5 as a regulator of immune evasion, showing that its targeting induces immunogenic cell death and anti tumor immunity.
papers.summary_ko: RNA 센서 MDA5가 종양 면역 회피를 촉진하며 환자의 낮은 생존율 및 면역관문억제제(ICB) 저항성과 관련됨을 보인 연구이다. MDA5를 표적하면 비접힘단백질반응(UPR) 기반 면역원성 세포사를 유도해 수지상세포의 항원 섭취와 T세포 활성화를 증가시킨다. 또한 MDA5 결손은 ASK1-JNK/P38 경로를 활성화해 TNF-α/IFN-γ에 대한 종양세포 감수성을 높여 ICB 치료 효과를 증대시킨다.

papers.title: Garnet-type LLZO solid electrolytes: grain-boundary engineering, electro-chemo-mechanical failure, and manufacturability
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Garnet-type lithium lanthanum zirconium oxide (Li 7 La 3 Zr 2 O 12 , LLZO) combines competitive room-temperature Li-ion conductivity, thermal stability, and comparatively favorable compatibility with lithium metal, yet these bulk properties have not translated into reliable solid-state batteries. This review develops a process–state–field–failure–performance framework in which LLZO reliability is governed by connected grain boundaries, pores, cracks, surface films, and poorly contacted interfaces that localize ionic current, electronic leakage, and mechanical stress. Quantitative structure–transport relationships are evaluated by separating bulk, grain-boundary, and total conductivity and activation-energy contributions, showing why cubic-phase stabilization, increased dopant concentration, or densification alone cannot predict pellet-scale transport. Emphasis is placed on grain-boundary chemistry, local mechanical softening, pore connectivity, stripping-induced contact loss, stack-pressure windows, and lithium-assisted fracture as coupled determinants of filament penetration and short circuit. Interface treatments, polymer composites, porous scaffolds, and thin-sheet architectures are critically assessed according to their ability to homogenize current distribution, disrupt connected defects, and maintain electrode contact. In situ and operando techniques are examined for resolving the progression from void formation and current focusing to crack opening and lithium intrusion. Manufacturing and commercial readiness are evaluated using electrolyte thickness, area-specific resistance, areal capacity, operating pressure, cycle life, defect-screening capability, and production yield rather than conductivity alone. Data-driven approaches are considered supporting tools for uncertainty-aware materials selection, process control, and quality assurance. Overall, durable and scalable LLZO batteries require coordinated disruption of connected electro-chemo-mechanical failure pathways rather than marginal optimization of isolated material properties.

papers.title: Dual‐Sided Regulation of Lithium Deposition for High‐Energy‐Density Anode‐Less Lithium Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Anode‐less lithium (Li) metal batteries are the ultimate anode configuration for high‐energy‐density energy storage, yet their practical adoption is hindered by uncontrolled Li dendrite growth. Here, we present a dual‐sided regulation strategy that homogenizes Li deposition through simultaneous bottom‐up and top‐down control. At the current collector, an ultrathin platinum (Pt) layer leverages its lithiophilicity to stabilize nucleation and promote dense bottom growth. At the separator, an amorphous tantalum oxide (a‐TaO x ) ceramic layer exploits thermodynamic Li dewetting to suppress upward dendritic propagation, enforcing top‐down uniformity. This synergistic Pt/a‐TaO x dual‐interface design orchestrates Li deposition across the entire electrode, enabling stable cycling at high cathode areal capacities (4.78 mAh cm– 2 ) with 70% capacity retention after 110 cycles in an anode‐less configuration (N/P ratio = 0) and 80% after 187 cycles with pre‐lithiation (N/P ratio = 0.42). By transcending conventional bottom‐only protection, this work establishes a new framework for stabilizing Li deposition across the full thickness in high‐capacity anode‐less Li metal batteries.

papers.title: Coordination‐Gated MOF@COF Functional Separators for Regulating Ion Flux in Lithium Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Functional separators that regulate ion transport before lithium ions (Li + ) reach the lithium metal surface are critical for mitigating dendritic deposition and interfacial instability in lithium metal batteries. However, most separator designs mainly emphasize Li + affinity or electrolyte wettability, while the migration and decomposition behavior of anions remains insufficiently controlled. Herein, a coordination‐gated anion‐sieving separator is developed by constructing a UiO‐66@F‐COF@Ni core–shell interlayer on commercial polypropylene. In this architecture, the UiO‐66 core provides stable porous transport channels, and the fluorinated imine‐linked COF shell creates a polar ion‐regulating interface. The introduced Ni 2+ coordination centers interact with PF 6 − to modulate anion migration and interfacial decomposition. Benefiting from the coupled MOF@COF heterointerface and anion‐sieving effect, the separator exhibits high ionic conductivity, enhanced Li + transference, and reduced interfacial resistance. The regulated ion flux alleviates concentration polarization, guides uniform Li deposition, and promotes the formation of a compact inorganic‐rich SEI. Consequently, LFP||Li batteries retain 126.1 mAh g −1 after 1200 cycles at 2.0 C, and high‐voltage NCM811||Li batteries maintain 141.4 mAh g −1 after 600 cycles at 3.0 C. This coordination‐regulated MOF@COF separator provides a practical strategy for stable, high‐rate, and high‐voltage lithium metal batteries.

papers.title: Regulated Co‐Solvation in Gel Polymer Electrolyte Enables Rapid and Selective Li + Ion Transport for High‐Rate Lithium Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT The development of gel polymer electrolytes (GPEs) suitable for high‐rate lithium metal batteries (LMBs) is urgently needed but remains inherently challenging. This difficulty originates from the competition between the polymer network and the liquid electrolyte for lithium ion (Li + ) coordination. Polymer‐dominated coordination traps Li + and slows transport, while solvent‐dominated solvation permits uncontrolled anion migration and causes concentration polarization. Here, we resolve this challenge by establishing a matched polymer–electrolyte co‐solvation state, which enables rapid and selective Li + transport via a cooperative mechanism. We implement this concept through a dual‐regulated weak‐coordination gel polymer electrolyte (DWGPE), which comprises a fluorinated polymer backbone that attenuates Li + binding, an amide‐functionalized crosslinker that immobilizes anions via hydrogen bonding, and a weakly solvating adiponitrile‐based liquid phase. Molecular dynamics simulations reveal a cooperative transport mechanism that integrates polymer‐assisted hopping and solvent‐mediated vehicular diffusion, while suppressing anion mobility. Consequently, Li||DWGPE||LFP coin cells sustain 10 000 cycles at 6 C with 65% capacity retention, corresponding to an ultralow capacity decay of 0.003% per cycle. Our DWGPE also operates stably with high‐voltage NCM811 cathodes and in ampere‐hour‐level pouch cells. This work establishes polymer–electrolyte co‐solvation as a design framework for high‐performance GPEs toward fast‐charging LMBs.
papers.summary_ko: 고속 충방전 리튬 금속 전지(LMB)를 위해 고분자-전해질이 Li+ 이온을 함께 조절하는 공용매화 젤 고분자 전해질(DWGPE)을 개발했다. 불소화 고분자 골격으로 Li+ 결합을 약화시키고 아미드 가교제의 수소결합으로 음이온 이동을 억제하며, 약하게 용매화하는 adiponitrile 액상을 결합해 고분자 보조 호핑과 용매 매개 확산이 함께 작동하는 협력적 Li+ 수송 메커니즘을 구현했다. Li||DWGPE||LFP 셀은 6C에서 10,000회 사이클 후 65% 용량을 유지했으며, 고전압 NCM811 양극과 암페어시급 파우치셀에서도 안정적으로 동작했다.

papers.title: Quaternary Ammonium Lignin Enabling High‐Na + ‐Conductivity Gel Electrolyte and NaF‐Rich SEI Toward High‐Safety Sodium Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Sodium metal batteries (SMBs) using gel polymer electrolytes (GPEs) are considered promising candidates for low‐cost, high energy density, and high‐safety energy storage devices. However, a persistent challenge lies in simultaneously achieving high Na + conductivity of GPEs and a stable solid electrolyte interphase (SEI) on a sodium metal anode. Herein, a quaternary ammonium lignin (QAL) incorporated poly(vinylidene fluoride‐co‐hexafluoropropylene) based GPE is designed to synergistically achieve high Na + conductivity and a stable SEI. The electron‐deficient quaternary ammonium groups of QAL strongly anchor anions and promote sodium bis(trifluoromethylsulfonyl)imide (NaTFSI) dissociation, achieving high Na + conductivity. Meanwhile, the π‐conjugated backbone of QAL enables efficient charge transfer from the unreacted region to the reactive site, providing sufficient charge for TFSI − anion decomposition and promoting the formation of a stable NaF‐rich SEI. As anticipated, the Na||Na symmetric batteries based on the designed GPEs demonstrate stable cycling over 5000 h, and the gel‐state Na||Na 3 V 2 (PO 4 ) 3 full batteries deliver high‐capacity retention of 96.9% after 4700 cycles at 10C. The gel‐state pouch full batteries exhibit excellent stability under mechanical abuse (folding, puncture, and cutting) and over a wide temperature range (−20°C to 60°C). This work synergistically achieves high Na + conductivity and a stable NaF‐rich SEI, paving the way for the development of stable and high‐safety SMBs.
papers.summary_ko: 4차 암모늄 리그닌(QAL)을 PVDF-HFP 기반 겔 전해질에 도입하여 Na+ 전도도를 높이고 NaF가 풍부한 안정적 SEI를 소듐 금속 음극에 형성했다. QAL의 4차 암모늄기가 음이온을 포획해 NaTFSI 해리를 촉진하고, π-공액 골격이 전하 이동을 매개하여 TFSI− 분해와 NaF-rich SEI 형성을 돕는다. Na||Na 대칭전지는 5000시간 이상 안정적으로 작동했고, Na||Na3V2(PO4)3 완전전지는 10C에서 4700사이클 후 96.9%의 용량 유지율을 보였으며 다양한 기계적·온도 조건에서도 안정성을 유지했다.

papers.title: Precious metal free tunable manganese oxides for sustainable anion exchange membrane fuel cells
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Eliminating platinum group metals from cathode catalysts in low-temperature polymer electrolyte fuel cells is highly important for addressing the sustainability challenge fuel cell systems face. Here, we propose modifying the electronic structure of Li-intercalated layered Mn-oxide as a cathode catalyst to overcome the activity/stability tradeoff in anion exchange membrane fuel cells. To achieve this goal, we deploy a precious metal free catalyst design strategy involving atomically dispersed p -block metal Sn doped in Li 2 MnO 3 , in addition to d -block metals, which has been poorly explored in the research thus far. Operando X-ray absorption spectroscopy and rapid freeze-quench 119 Sn Mössbauer methodology are employed to visualize the catalytic dynamics, revealing that part of Mn 4+ ions are converted into Mn 3+ ions, whereas Sn 4+ ions remain unchanged during the oxygen reduction reaction. Under H 2 /O 2 conditions, anion exchange membrane fuel cells employing Li 2 Mn 0.9 Sn 0.1 O 3 cathodes achieve peak power densities above 1.0 W cm -2 geo and 3.96 W mg -1 Pt . This work demonstrates the beneficial modulation of the electronic structure through p -block metal substitution in earth-abundant Mn-enriched oxide materials.
papers.summary_ko: 저온 고분자 전해질 음이온교환막 연료전지에서 백금족 금속을 대체하기 위해 Li2MnO3에 p-블록 금속인 Sn을 도핑한 비귀금속 촉매를 제안했다. 오퍼랜도 XAS와 119Sn 뫼스바우어 분광법으로 산소환원반응 중 Mn4+가 Mn3+로 전환되는 반면 Sn4+는 변하지 않음을 확인했다. Li2Mn0.9Sn0.1O3 촉매를 적용한 연료전지는 1.0 W/cm² 이상의 높은 최고 출력밀도를 달성했다.

papers.title: Pioneering MOF-303 in Lithium–Sulfur Batteries: Coordination Defect Engineering Enables Accelerated Sulfur Redox and Dendrite-Free Plating
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Lithium–sulfur (Li–S) batteries are severely hindered by the shuttle effect of lithium polysulfides (LiPSs) and uncontrolled lithium dendrite growth. Herein, a defect-engineered MOF-303 (D-MOF-303) modified separator is developed via a ball-milling strategy to simultaneously mitigate both issues, marking the first application of MOF-303 in the Li–S battery field. The intentional introduction of ligand defects and oxygen vacancies reduces particle size, establishes a hierarchical porous structure, and amplifies local Lewis acidity. Consequently, the D-MOF-303 coating layer provides exceptional chemisorption and accelerated electrocatalytic conversion kinetics for LiPSs, while concurrently homogenizing lithium-ion flux to achieve long-term dendrite-free lithium plating. Benefiting from these synergistic merits, the resulting Li–S full cells exhibit high capacity retention over 500 cycles at 0.5 C, enhanced rate capability up to 3 C, and notable environmental resilience under high-humidity aging conditions. This work demonstrates the potential of coordination defect engineering in metal–organic frameworks for advancing high-energy-density and commercially viable energy storage technologies.
papers.summary_ko: 리튬-황 전지의 폴리설파이드 셔틀효과와 리튬 덴드라이트 문제를 동시에 해결하기 위해 결함이 도입된 MOF-303(D-MOF-303)으로 분리막을 코팅했다. 리간드 결함과 산소 공공으로 입자가 작아지고 계층적 다공 구조와 강한 루이스 산성이 형성되어 폴리설파이드 화학흡착과 전환 반응이 가속화되며, 리튬 이온 플럭스가 균일화되어 장기간 덴드라이트 없는 리튬 도금이 가능해졌다. 이를 적용한 Li-S 완전전지는 0.5C에서 500사이클 이상 높은 용량 유지율과 3C까지의 우수한 율속 특성을 보였다.

papers.title: Multi-model collaborative early warning for battery systems with integrated fiber optic sensors
papers.abstract_en: Abstract The safety assessment of battery systems is constrained by sparse temperature measurements and monolithic diagnostic frameworks in conventional battery management systems (BMS). To address this, we propose a multi-model collaborative thermal-runaway early-warning framework using distributed temperature sensing. An integrated sensing scheme increases temperature sensing points within the battery pack from 32 to 540 with minimal wiring complexity and is validated in real-world vehicle operation. We establish a functional relationship between temperature Shannon entropy (SE) and average temperature variation to derive a dynamic warning boundary incorporating error tolerance. Integrating this boundary with thresholds for temperature, temperature change rate, and SE change rate enables collaborative early warning. Compared with conventional BMS warning benchmarks, the framework provides maximum warning lead times of 706 s in laboratory modules and 554 s in real-world vehicle operation. These findings demonstrate the potential of distributed sensing and collaborative diagnostics for proactive thermal-runaway risk identification.
